fundamentals.definition_zh: 一种同时匹配函数值和一阶导数值的多项式插值方法。给定 n+1 个节点的函数值和导数值，构造 2n+1 次多项式。相比只匹配函数值的 Lagrange 插值，Hermite 插值在相同节点数下精度更高、曲线更光滑。论文将其用于替换 DE 历表的 Chebyshev 拟合来计算日月位置。
fundamentals.definition_en: A polynomial interpolation method that matches both function values and first derivatives at given nodes, producing a polynomial of degree 2n+1 from n+1 nodes. It offers smoother interpolation than Lagrange interpolation and is used in this paper to replace Chebyshev polynomial fitting for computing solar and lunar positions.
sources: Lv et al., 2025

fundamentals.definition_zh: JPL DE 历表中表示天体位置的标准方法。将位置数据拟合为 Chebyshev 多项式级数，每 32 天为一段，月球需 312 个系数，太阳需 66 个系数。优势是数值稳定、逼近误差均匀分布，但参数量较大，不适合星载存储受限场景。
fundamentals.definition_en: The standard representation method in JPL DE ephemerides for celestial body positions. Position data over 32-day segments are fitted to Chebyshev polynomial series, requiring 312 coefficients for the Moon and 66 for the Sun. While numerically stable, the parameter count is high for onboard storage-constrained applications.
sources: Lv et al., 2025

fundamentals.definition_zh: 由 GRAIL 月球重力场探测任务数据解算的月球引力场球谐模型。「PRIM」表示使用了主成分方法处理的版本。是当前精度最高的月球重力场模型之一，适用于需要精确月球引力的高保真轨道动力学研究。
fundamentals.definition_en: A lunar gravity field spherical harmonic model derived from GRAIL mission data. The 'PRIM' designation indicates the use of a primary component solution method. It is among the most accurate lunar gravity models available, suitable for high-fidelity orbital dynamics studies requiring precise lunar gravity.
sources: Zhang et al., 2022

fundamentals.zh: 太阳系质心天球坐标系
fundamentals.definition_zh: 以太阳系质心为原点的时间空间参考系，用于在地月空间星间测距数据处理中描述探测器位置和速度。
fundamentals.definition_en: A space-time reference system with its origin at the solar system barycenter, used to describe spacecraft position and velocity in cislunar inter-satellite link data processing.
sources: 黄勇 等 - 2023 - 地月空间探测器星间测距自主定轨

fundamentals.definition_zh: 以地球质心为原点的时间空间参考系，可通过洛伦兹变换与BCRS相互转换。
fundamentals.definition_en: A space-time reference system with its origin at the Earth's center, which can be transformed to BCRS via Lorentz transformation.
sources: 黄勇 等 - 2023 - 地月空间探测器星间测距自主定轨

fundamentals.definition_zh: 以太阳能电池阵供电的电推进系统，将电能转化为推进剂动能产生推力。推力小（典型推力加速度量级 10⁻⁵g₀）但比冲高（3000 s 以上），能以较少推进剂完成长航程任务。深空一号和ESA SMART-1 验证了其可行性。
fundamentals.definition_en: An electric propulsion system powered by solar arrays that converts electrical energy into propellant kinetic energy. It produces low thrust (typically ~10⁻⁵g₀) but high specific impulse (>3000 s), enabling long-duration missions with less propellant. Demonstrated by Deep Space 1 and ESA SMART-1.
sources: Yang - 2007 - Earth-moon trajectory optimization using solar electric propulsion

fundamentals.definition_zh: 描述椭圆轨道上天体位置的角度参数，定义为辅助圆上对应点与近地点之间的圆心角。通过开普勒方程与时间建立联系，在轨道力学解析推导中比真近点角更便于积分运算。
fundamentals.definition_en: An angular parameter describing a body's position on an elliptical orbit, defined as the central angle on the auxiliary circle between the corresponding point and periapsis. Connected to time via Kepler's equation, it is more convenient than true anomaly for analytical integration in orbital mechanics derivations.
sources: Yang - 2007 - Earth-moon trajectory optimization using solar electric propulsion

fundamentals.definition_zh: 单位时间内推进剂的消耗速率，等于推力除以比冲与重力加速度之积（ṁ = T/(g₀Isp)）。它是运动方程中质量状态变量的微分方程右端项，是燃料最优轨迹优化的基本约束之一。
fundamentals.definition_en: The rate of propellant consumption per unit time, equal to thrust divided by the product of specific impulse and gravitational acceleration (ṁ = T/(g₀Isp)). It appears as the right-hand side of the mass state equation and is a fundamental constraint in fuel-optimal trajectory optimization.
sources: Yang - 2007 - Earth-moon trajectory optimization using solar electric propulsion
Thorne 1996

fundamentals.definition_zh: 以月心为原点、随月球自转一起旋转的坐标系。在此坐标系下，月面各点位置固定，便于分析卫星对月面特定区域的可见性和覆盖性能。
fundamentals.definition_en: A coordinate system centered at the Moon's center of mass that rotates with the lunar body. In this frame, surface points are fixed, making it convenient to analyze satellite visibility and coverage of specific lunar regions.
sources: 陈诗雨 等 - 2024 - 近月空间星座轨道设计方法

fundamentals.definition_zh: 层次分析法中的核心工具，通过两两比较各指标的相对重要性来确定权重。矩阵中第 i 行第 j 列的值表示指标 i 相对于指标 j 的优先程度，值越大表示 i 的优先级越高。论文用此矩阵确定中继通信和导航各项指标的权重。
fundamentals.definition_en: A core tool in the Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) that determines weights through pairwise comparison of criteria importance. The element at row i, column j indicates the priority of criterion i relative to criterion j, with larger values meaning higher priority. The paper uses this matrix to weight relay communication and navigation performance indices.
sources: 陈诗雨 等 - 2024 - 近月空间星座轨道设计方法

fundamentals.definition_zh: 参数估计精度的理论下限，表示无偏估计器在最优条件下所能达到的最小方差。在自主轨道确定中用于验证观测系统的可观测性：若CRLB表明位置精度可收敛至某量级，则实际滤波器在理想条件下至少能达到该精度。CRLB计算使用参考轨道而非估计轨道，且不包含过程噪声。
fundamentals.definition_en: The theoretical lower bound on parameter estimation accuracy, representing the minimum variance achievable by an unbiased estimator under optimal conditions. In autonomous orbit determination, the CRLB validates observability of the measurement system. The CRLB uses the reference orbit (not the estimated orbit) and excludes process noise.
sources: Chen et al., 2025, Aerospace 12, 576

fundamentals.definition_zh: 一种非线性滤波方法，通过选取一组确定性采样点（sigma点）来捕捉均值和协方差的非线性变换，避免了扩展卡尔曼滤波对非线性函数求导的需求。在地月空间初轨确定中用于处理高度非线性的轨道动力学。
fundamentals.definition_en: A nonlinear filtering method that captures nonlinear transformations of mean and covariance through deterministic sampling points (sigma points), avoiding the need for Jacobian computation required by the Extended Kalman Filter. Applied to highly nonlinear cislunar orbit determination problems.
sources: 于登云 等 - 2025 - 人工智能赋能地月空间感知技术现状及展望

fundamentals.definition_zh: 用多个高斯分布的加权叠加来描述数据的概率密度模型。在地月空间目标轨道确定中，用于表示轨道状态的多峰概率分布，能在测量信息缺失时维持目标的持续跟踪。
fundamentals.definition_en: A probabilistic density model that represents data as a weighted sum of multiple Gaussian distributions. In cislunar orbit determination, it represents multimodal probability distributions of orbital states, enabling sustained tracking even when measurement data is partially missing.
sources: 于登云 等 - 2025 - 人工智能赋能地月空间感知技术现状及展望

fundamentals.definition_zh: 由输入层、若干隐藏层和输出层组成的前馈神经网络，每层神经元与下一层全连接。在地月空间感知中用于修正低轨目标的TLE数据，使超过85%的目标误差减少至少30%。
fundamentals.definition_en: A feedforward neural network consisting of an input layer, hidden layers, and an output layer with full connections between adjacent layers. Used in cislunar awareness to correct TLE data for LEO targets, reducing errors by at least 30% for over 85% of targets.
sources: 于登云 等 - 2025 - 人工智能赋能地月空间感知技术现状及展望

fundamentals.definition_zh: 具有循环连接的神经网络，能处理序列数据中的时序依赖关系。在轨道预测中，基于径向-切向-法向坐标系下的历史轨道数据进行时序建模，可将16天内的TLE预测误差减少45%。
fundamentals.definition_en: A neural network with recurrent connections that processes temporal dependencies in sequential data. In orbit prediction, it models temporal patterns in historical orbital data in the RTN coordinate frame, reducing TLE prediction errors by 45% within 16 days.
sources: 于登云 等 - 2025 - 人工智能赋能地月空间感知技术现状及展望

fundamentals.definition_zh: 神经网络中的一种特征加权策略，通过动态分配不同区域或通道的权重，使模型聚焦于关键信息。在空间目标检测中，通道与空间注意力模块可增强图像特征融合效果，提升暗弱目标的检测精度。
fundamentals.definition_en: A feature weighting strategy in neural networks that dynamically assigns weights to different regions or channels, enabling the model to focus on key information. In space object detection, channel and spatial attention modules enhance image feature fusion, improving faint object detection accuracy.
sources: 于登云 等 - 2025 - 人工智能赋能地月空间感知技术现状及展望

fundamentals.definition_zh: 一种多尺度特征提取架构，通过自底向上和自上而下的路径结合不同分辨率的特征图，使神经网络能同时检测大尺度和小尺度目标。在空间目标检测中与深度残差网络配合使用。
fundamentals.definition_en: A multi-scale feature extraction architecture that combines feature maps of different resolutions through bottom-up and top-down pathways, enabling neural networks to detect both large and small objects. Used together with ResNet in space object detection.
sources: 于登云 等 - 2025 - 人工智能赋能地月空间感知技术现状及展望

fundamentals.definition_zh: 通过引入跳跃连接（残差连接）解决深层网络退化问题的卷积神经网络架构。ResNet-50等模型作为空间目标检测的基础骨干网络，能从天文图像中提取深层特征。
fundamentals.definition_en: A convolutional neural network architecture that solves the degradation problem of deep networks through skip connections (residual connections). Models like ResNet-50 serve as backbone networks for space object detection, extracting deep features from astronomical images.
sources: 于登云 等 - 2025 - 人工智能赋能地月空间感知技术现状及展望

fundamentals.definition_zh: 共线平动点中心流形所关联的稳定流形与不稳定流形的总称。其中稳定流形上的轨道随时间推移指数趋近参考轨道，不稳定流形上的轨道则指数远离。双曲流形呈管状结构，在平动点附近的动力学中起通道作用，是利用不变流形设计转移轨道的基础。
fundamentals.definition_en: The collection of stable and unstable invariant manifolds associated with the central manifold of a collinear libration point. Trajectories on the stable manifold approach the reference orbit exponentially forward in time; those on the unstable manifold depart exponentially. These tube-shaped structures serve as dynamical conduits near libration points and form the basis for manifold-based transfer orbit design.
sources: Alessi 等 - 2009 - Leaving the moon by means of invariant manifolds of libration point orbits

fundamentals.definition_zh: 一种半解析级数展开方法，通过引入幅值和相位参数，构造周期轨道和准周期轨道的形式级数解及其流形的高阶近似。该方法能处理运动方程的高阶非线性项，展开阶数可达25阶以上，提供无需进一步修正的初始条件。展开式对应Birkhoff正规形方程的解。
fundamentals.definition_en: A semi-analytical series expansion method that constructs formal series solutions of periodic and quasi-periodic orbits and their manifolds in terms of amplitudes and phases. It incorporates high-order nonlinear terms of the equations of motion, achieving expansions up to order 25 or higher that provide initial conditions without further refinement. The expansions correspond to solutions of the Birkhoff normal form equations.
sources: Masdemont - 2005 - High order expansions of invariant manifolds of libration point orbits with applications to mission design

fundamentals.definition_zh: 通过正则变换将平动点附近的哈密顿函数化简为仅含作用量变量的形式，去除非共振项。Lindstedt-Poincaré展开式即为Birkhoff正规形方程的形式级数解。
fundamentals.definition_en: A canonical transformation that simplifies the Hamiltonian near an equilibrium point to a form depending only on action variables, eliminating non-resonant terms. The Lindstedt-Poincaré series expansions correspond to formal series solutions of the Birkhoff normal form equations.
sources: Alessi 等 - 2009 - Leaving the moon by means of invariant manifolds of libration point orbits

fundamentals.definition_zh: 在圆型限制性三体问题中，由雅可比常数决定的质点允许运动区域。零速度曲面将构型空间分为允许区和禁区，随着雅可比常数变化，希尔区域呈现五种不同的几何形态，从完全连通到形成围绕各天体的独立区域。
fundamentals.definition_en: In the Circular Restricted Three-Body Problem, the region of allowed motion in configuration space determined by the Jacobi constant. Zero-velocity surfaces divide the space into allowed and forbidden regions. As the Jacobi constant varies, Hill regions exhibit five distinct geometric configurations, ranging from fully connected to separate regions enclosing each primary.
sources: Szebehely - 1967 - Theory of orbits

fundamentals.definition_zh: 相空间中的高维曲面，准周期轨道在其上运动。每个环面由基本频率刻画，当幅值趋于零时趋向平动点的特征频率。Lissajous轨道对应二维不变环面，准halo轨道围绕周期halo轨道的环面运动。周期轨道通过分岔从环面族中产生。
fundamentals.definition_en: A higher-dimensional surface in phase space on which quasi-periodic orbits evolve. Each torus is characterized by its fundamental frequencies, which tend to the characteristic frequencies of the libration point as amplitudes approach zero. Lissajous orbits correspond to two-dimensional invariant tori. Periodic orbits emerge from families of tori through bifurcation.
sources: Alessi 等 - 2009 - Leaving the moon by means of invariant manifolds of libration point orbits
Meyer和Offin - 2017

fundamentals.definition_zh: 航天器脱离天体引力束缚所需的最低速度。月球逃逸速度约为2.4千米每秒。在基于不变流形的月面出发中，出发速度接近月球逃逸速度，这是由雅可比积分约束决定的。
fundamentals.definition_en: The minimum speed required for a spacecraft to escape a celestial body's gravitational pull. The lunar escape velocity is approximately 2.4 km/s. In manifold-based lunar departures, the departure velocity is close to the lunar escape velocity, a consequence of the Jacobi integral constraint.
sources: Alessi 等 - 2009 - Leaving the moon by means of invariant manifolds of libration point orbits
Belbruno 等 - 2010 - Weak stability boundary and invariant manifolds
Topputo 2013
轨道力学 第3章
Vepa - 2024 - Space vehicle maneuvering, propulsion, dynamics and control

fundamentals.definition_zh: 基于动力学系统理论的轨道设计软件，用于生成平动点轨道及其不变流形。
fundamentals.definition_en: Trajectory design software based on dynamical systems theory, used to generate libration point orbits and their invariant manifolds.
sources: Trajectory selection strategy for tours in the Earth-moon system

fundamentals.definition_zh: JPL开发的平动点轨道设计工具。
fundamentals.definition_en: Libration point orbit design tool developed by JPL.
sources: Trajectory selection strategy for tours in the Earth-moon system

fundamentals.definition_zh: 用于周期轨道计算、数值延拓及分岔检测与分析的软件。
fundamentals.definition_en: Software for periodic orbit computation, numerical continuation, and bifurcation detection and analysis.
sources: Trajectory selection strategy for tours in the Earth-moon system

fundamentals.definition_zh: 两天体系统中与两天体保持相对固定位置的平衡点，地月系统有五个平动点（L1至L5）。
fundamentals.definition_en: Equilibrium points maintaining fixed relative positions to two bodies in a two-body system; Earth-Moon system has five libration points (L1-L5).
sources: Trajectory selection strategy for tours in the Earth-moon system
Parker和Anderson - 2014 - Low-energy lunar trajectory design

fundamentals.definition_zh: 地月系统中与地球相反侧的平动点，位于月球轨道之外。
fundamentals.definition_en: Libration point on the opposite side of Earth from the Moon, beyond the lunar orbit.
sources: Trajectory selection strategy for tours in the Earth-moon system

fundamentals.definition_zh: 地月系统中与地球、月球构成等边三角形前方的平动点（三角平动点之一）。
fundamentals.definition_en: One of triangular libration points in Earth-Moon system, leading Earth-Moon by 60 degrees in orbital motion.
sources: Trajectory selection strategy for tours in the Earth-moon system

fundamentals.definition_zh: 地月系统中与地球、月球构成等边三角形后方的平动点（三角平动点之一）。
fundamentals.definition_en: One of triangular libration points in Earth-Moon system, trailing Earth-Moon by 60 degrees in orbital motion.
sources: Trajectory selection strategy for tours in the Earth-moon system

fundamentals.definition_zh: 将函数映射为等价类，通过代数运算自动传递各阶偏导数信息的计算方法。用于高效计算高阶状态转移张量，避免二阶以上符号微分带来的表达式膨胀。
fundamentals.definition_en: A method that maps functions into equivalence classes and propagates derivative information of all orders through algebraic operations. Used to efficiently compute high-order state transition tensors, avoiding the expression explosion of symbolic differentiation beyond second order.
sources: Di Lizia et al. 2008

fundamentals.definition_zh: 张量分析中省略求和符号的简记法：同一指标同时出现在上标和下标时，表示对该指标所有分量自动求和。在高阶状态转移张量表达式中用于简洁描述多维偏导数展开。
fundamentals.definition_en: A notational convention in tensor analysis that omits the summation symbol: when the same index appears as both superscript and subscript, summation over all components of that index is implied. Used in high-order state transition tensor expressions to concisely describe multi-dimensional partial derivative expansions.
sources: Park and Scheeres 2007

fundamentals.definition_zh: 随两主天体连线旋转的参考系。原点在地月质心，X轴指向月球，Z轴沿系统角动量方向。在此坐标系中两主天体位置固定，圆形限制性三体问题的运动方程呈自治形式。
fundamentals.definition_en: A reference frame rotating with the line connecting two primary bodies. Its origin is at the Earth–Moon barycenter, the X-axis points toward the Moon, and the Z-axis aligns with the system's angular momentum. In this frame the two primaries are stationary and the circular restricted three-body problem takes an autonomous form.
sources: Szebehely 1967

fundamentals.definition_zh: 将光滑函数在参考点处表示为各阶导数幂级数的数学工具。高阶状态转移张量即通过泰勒展开近似轨道偏差与初始扰动之间的非线性关系，阶数越高近似越精确。
fundamentals.definition_en: A mathematical tool that represents a smooth function as a power series of derivatives evaluated at a reference point. High-order state transition tensors use Taylor expansion to approximate the nonlinear relationship between orbital deviations and initial perturbations; higher order yields better accuracy.
sources: Yin et al. 2023

fundamentals.definition_zh: 一类直接法最优控制求解方法。用Legendre-Gauss配点将连续最优控制问题离散为非线性规划（NLP）问题。动力学约束只涉及当前节点状态，参数规模小；配点处的KKT条件等价于极大值原理的一阶最优性条件，精度高；具有伪谱法共有的指数收敛特性。在平动点轨道转移设计中，配合形状法提供的初值，可将迭代次数降低55%以上。
fundamentals.definition_en: A direct method for solving optimal control problems. It discretizes the continuous optimal control problem into a nonlinear programming (NLP) problem using Legendre-Gauss collocation points. Dynamics constraints depend only on the current node state, keeping the parameter space small. The KKT conditions at collocation points are equivalent to the first-order optimality conditions of the Pontryagin maximum principle, yielding high accuracy. It inherits the exponential convergence property of pseudospectral methods.
sources: 平动点周期轨道间小推力转移的Gauss伪谱法

fundamentals.definition_zh: 一种高精度数值积分方法。取Legendre多项式的根为积分节点，配以对应的求积权重，对被积函数在区间上进行加权求和，达到2n-1阶代数精度。在Gauss伪谱法中，用于将动力学方程积分转为代数约束，以及离散目标函数中的积分项。
fundamentals.definition_en: A high-accuracy numerical integration method. It uses the roots of Legendre polynomials as integration nodes with corresponding quadrature weights, achieving algebraic accuracy of order 2n-1. In the Gauss pseudospectral method, it converts dynamics equation integrals into algebraic constraints and discretizes integral terms in the objective function.
sources: 平动点周期轨道间小推力转移的Gauss伪谱法

fundamentals.definition_zh: 一种多项式插值方法。用n+1个节点处的函数值构造n次多项式，使其恰好经过所有节点。在Gauss伪谱法中，以初始状态和各LG配点处的状态为节点，构造Lagrange插值多项式来逼近状态变量，并对其求导获得配点处的状态导数，从而将微分方程转为代数约束。
fundamentals.definition_en: A polynomial interpolation method. It constructs a degree-n polynomial from function values at n+1 nodes that passes through all nodes exactly. In the Gauss pseudospectral method, Lagrange interpolation polynomials approximate state variables using the initial state and states at LG collocation points, with derivatives obtained by differentiating the polynomial to convert differential equations into algebraic constraints.
sources: 平动点周期轨道间小推力转移的Gauss伪谱法

fundamentals.definition_zh: Legendre多项式在开区间(-1,1)内的根。在Gauss伪谱法中作为离散配点使用，对应区间内部的K个点，不含端点。每个LG点处建立动力学约束方程，并通过Gauss求积公式处理末端约束。
fundamentals.definition_en: The roots of Legendre polynomials in the open interval (-1, 1). Used as collocation points in the Gauss pseudospectral method, these K interior points exclude the endpoints. Dynamics constraints are established at each LG point, and terminal constraints are handled via the Gauss quadrature formula.
sources: 平动点周期轨道间小推力转移的Gauss伪谱法

fundamentals.definition_zh: 一种将微分方程中常数参数替换为待定函数的求解技术。在本文中，将平动点附近周期轨道一阶近似解的振幅和相位视为时变函数，通过多项式拟合转移轨道的螺旋特性，由此构造适用于Gauss伪谱法的形状函数。
fundamentals.definition_en: A technique that replaces constant parameters in differential equations with undetermined functions. In this paper, the amplitudes and phases of the first-order approximate periodic orbit solution near libration points are treated as time-varying functions, fitted by polynomials to capture the spiral nature of transfer trajectories.
sources: 平动点周期轨道间小推力转移的Gauss伪谱法

fundamentals.definition_zh: 一种数值求解微分方程的离散化方法。以Legendre多项式根（LG点）为配点，用Lagrange插值多项式逼近解函数，在每个配点处要求微分方程成立，从而将连续问题转为有限维代数方程组。是Gauss伪谱法的核心离散化技术。
fundamentals.definition_en: A discretization method for numerically solving differential equations. It uses Legendre polynomial roots (LG points) as collocation points, approximates the solution function with Lagrange interpolation polynomials, and enforces the differential equation at each collocation point, converting the continuous problem into a finite-dimensional algebraic system. This is the core discretization technique of the Gauss pseudospectral method.
sources: 平动点周期轨道间小推力转移的Gauss伪谱法

fundamentals.definition_zh: 一种参数确定方法。通过反复尝试和验证来确定满足约束条件的参数值。在本文中用于确定形状函数近似解析解的多项式系数，配合事后过程约束检验。
fundamentals.definition_en: A parameter determination method that identifies values satisfying constraints through repeated attempts and verification. In this paper, it is used to determine the polynomial coefficients of the approximate analytical solution from the shape function, combined with post-hoc process constraint validation.
sources: 平动点周期轨道间小推力转移的Gauss伪谱法

fundamentals.definition_zh: 伊利诺伊大学厄巴纳-香槟分校空间态势感知与空间可持续性（SSASSI）课题组开发的轨迹优化与任务设计软件工具包，支持高保真 n 体动力学模型、间接最优控制、打ち靶法等算法，用于本文地月转移轨道的数值仿真。
fundamentals.definition_en: A trajectory optimization and mission design software toolkit developed by the Space Situational Awareness and Space Sustainability (SSASSI) group at the University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign. It supports high-fidelity n-body dynamical models, indirect optimal control methods, and shooting algorithms, used in this paper for cislunar transfer trajectory simulation.
sources: Patrick 等 - 2023

fundamentals.definition_zh: 一种提升间接法收敛域的技术。将协态变量从原始坐标系映射到新的参数空间，使优化初值对协态猜测的敏感性降低，从而让打靶法能在更大的初值范围内收敛。对推力加速度极低、需要数百圈螺旋飞行的转移问题尤其有效。
fundamentals.definition_en: A technique to expand the convergence domain of indirect optimal control methods by mapping costate variables to a transformed parameter space, reducing sensitivity to initial costate guesses. Especially effective for very low-thrust transfers requiring hundreds of spiral revolutions.
sources: Patrick 等 - 2023 - Hybrid optimization of high-fidelity low-thrust transfers to the lunar gateway

fundamentals.definition_zh: 用缩放的角动量矢量和偏心率矢量描述轨道，从而快速估算两条轨道之间转移所需速度增量的方法。把两条轨道在 h-e 空间中的距离直接当作近似速度增量，可以在大候选集中快速筛除昂贵的注入点，大幅减少精确优化的计算量。
fundamentals.definition_en: A method using scaled angular momentum and eccentricity vectors to rapidly estimate the delta-V cost between two orbits. The Cartesian distance in h-e space approximates transfer cost, enabling fast pre-filtering of candidate injection points before detailed optimization.
sources: Gustafson et al. 2013; Patrick 等 - 2023

fundamentals.definition_zh: 一种日食几何模型，把遮挡体（如地球）的阴影区建模为锥形体。与将阴影简化为无限长圆柱的柱形阴影模型相比，锥形模型能更真实地反映半影区和本影区的形状，适用于需要精确计算日食时间窗口的低推力转移设计。
fundamentals.definition_en: An eclipse geometric model representing the shadow of an occulting body as a conical volume. Compared to the cylindrical shadow model, it more accurately captures penumbra and umbra geometry, which is important for precise eclipse duration estimation in low-thrust trajectory design.
sources: Aziz et al. 2019; Patrick 等 - 2023

fundamentals.definition_zh: 将全程低推力转移拆分成多段后，相邻两个拼接点之间的那一段最优转移弧段。每段独立求解两点边值问题，在拼接点处只保证状态连续、允许协态跳变（在滑行弧内）。分段处理使极长飞行时间、极低推力加速度的问题变得可收敛。
fundamentals.definition_en: A single optimal trajectory segment between two adjacent patch points in a patched multi-segment low-thrust transfer. Each leg is independently solved as a two-point boundary value problem, with state continuity enforced at patch points while costate discontinuities are permitted during coast arcs.
sources: Patrick 等 - 2023 - Hybrid optimization of high-fidelity low-thrust transfers to the lunar gateway

fundamentals.definition_zh: 沿轨道族连续追踪的一类数值方法。取族中一条已知轨道的初始条件，沿某个参数（如远月点横坐标x0）做微小增量变化，以当前解为初值迭代求解下一个轨道，逐步扫出整个轨道族。该方法比从零搜索高效得多，是Halo轨道族计算的标准手段。
fundamentals.definition_en: A class of numerical methods that traces an orbit family continuously. Starting from a known orbit's initial conditions, the parameter (e.g., the apolune abscissa x0) is incrementally changed, and the current solution seeds the iteration for the next orbit, sweeping out the entire family. This approach is far more efficient than searching from scratch and is the standard technique for computing halo orbit families.
sources: Conti and Circi, 2025, Design of halo orbit constellation for lunar global positioning and communication services

fundamentals.definition_zh: 判断周期轨道稳定性的一对指标nu1和nu2，定义为单值矩阵非单位特征值的模。当两个指数均为实数且绝对值不超过1时，轨道线性稳定，扰动不会指数增长；若出现复数或模大于1，轨道不稳定，需主动控制维持。
fundamentals.definition_en: A pair of indices nu1 and nu2 used to assess the stability of a periodic orbit, defined as the moduli of the non-unity eigenvalues of the monodromy matrix. When both indices are real-valued with absolute value at most 1, the orbit is linearly stable and perturbations do not grow exponentially. If complex or exceeding unity in modulus, the orbit is unstable and requires active control.
sources: Conti and Circi, 2025, Design of halo orbit constellation for lunar global positioning and communication services; Howell, 1984

fundamentals.definition_zh: 一种交互式地月系统轨道设计工具。与静态数据库不同，它按需实时计算周期轨道族的特征参数（尺寸、周期、雅可比常数、稳定性指数、转移成本、飞行时间、维持成本等），允许用户筛选、比较和导出候选轨道，为初步任务设计提供快速决策框架。
fundamentals.definition_en: An interactive trajectory design tool for the Earth-Moon system. Unlike a static database, it computes periodic orbit family parameters (size, period, Jacobi constant, stability index, transfer cost, time-of-flight, station-keeping cost, etc.) on demand, enabling users to filter, compare, and export candidate orbits as a rapid decision framework for preliminary mission design.
sources: Folta et al., 2015

fundamentals.definition_zh: 用于同时比较多组轨道族特征参数的统计可视化方法。对每个轨道族计算均值、范围和标准差，以圆点图（均值位圆心、半径代表范围缩放值）或柱状图（显示上下界）呈现，便于从大量候选族中快速筛选。
fundamentals.definition_en: A statistical visualization method for simultaneously comparing characteristic parameters across multiple orbit families. For each family, mean, range, and standard deviation are computed and displayed as dot plots (mean at center, radius scaled to range) or bar charts (showing upper and lower bounds), facilitating rapid screening from a large set of candidate families.
sources: Folta et al., 2015

fundamentals.definition_zh: 描述航天器在特定动力学模型下运动规律的微分方程组。在圆型限制性三体问题中，运动方程在会合坐标系（旋转参考系）下建立，包含两主天体的引力和旋转坐标系的科里奥利力、离心力项，形式为三个二阶常微分方程。有效势能函数对各方向的偏导数构成方程的右端项。运动方程是周期轨道计算、不变流形生成和转移轨道设计的数学基础。
fundamentals.definition_en: The system of differential equations governing spacecraft motion in a given dynamical model. In the CR3BP, the EOMs are formulated in the synodic (rotating) reference frame and include gravitational attraction from both primaries as well as Coriolis and centrifugal terms arising from the frame rotation, yielding three second-order ODEs. Partial derivatives of the effective potential function form the right-hand side. The EOMs are the mathematical foundation for computing periodic orbits, generating invariant manifolds, and designing transfer trajectories.
sources: Fossà 等 - 2022 - Two and three impulses phasing strategy with a spacecraft orbiting on an Earth–Moon NRHO

fundamentals.definition_zh: 同时包含整数变量和连续实数变量的数学规划方法。在多目标交会问题中，交会序列是整数变量（哪个先交哪个后交），出发和到达时间是连续变量，两类变量耦合在一起优化，典型的做法是先用启发式算法确定整数部分，再用梯度方法精调连续部分。
fundamentals.definition_en: A mathematical programming approach involving both integer and continuous real-valued variables. In multitarget rendezvous problems, the visiting sequence is an integer variable while departure and arrival times are continuous variables.
sources: 地月平动点小推力多目标交会任务设计与分析, 宇航学报, 2025

fundamentals.definition_zh: 旅行商问题的推广形式。标准旅行商问题中两城市间的代价是固定的，而时间依赖旅行商问题中代价随出发时间变化。在多目标交会中，两颗卫星间的转移代价取决于何时出发（因为目标在轨道上运动，位置随时间变化），因此建模为时间依赖旅行商问题。
fundamentals.definition_en: A generalization of the traveling salesman problem where the cost between cities varies with departure time. In multi-target rendezvous, the transfer cost between two satellites depends on when the spacecraft departs, since target positions change over time.
sources: 地月平动点小推力多目标交会任务设计与分析, 宇航学报, 2025

fundamentals.definition_zh: 在交会轨迹数据库生成中，利用发动机末时刻状态和占空比判断轨迹是否已进入「代价平台期」，提前终止延拓以去除无效数据的策略。该策略可在几乎不损失最优性的前提下，将数据库体量缩减至约40%、生成耗时缩短60%以上。
fundamentals.definition_en: A strategy for trajectory database generation that uses the engine's terminal state and duty cycle to detect when trajectories enter a cost plateau, terminating continuation early to remove redundant data while preserving near-optimal solutions.
sources: 地月平动点小推力多目标交会任务设计与分析, 宇航学报, 2025

fundamentals.definition_zh: 发动机开机时间占总飞行时间的比例，定义为发动机开启时长与轨迹总时长之比。占空比为1表示全程开机（时间最优），接近0表示大部分时间滑行（燃料最优）。在截断策略中，占空比低于设定阈值且末时刻发动机关闭时，即可判定进入代价平台期。
fundamentals.definition_en: The ratio of engine active time to total flight time. A duty cycle of 1 indicates full-thrust flight (time-optimal), while near 0 indicates mostly coasting (fuel-optimal). Used as a truncation criterion to detect cost plateaus in trajectory databases.
sources: 地月平动点小推力多目标交会任务设计与分析, 宇航学报, 2025

fundamentals.definition_zh: 衡量轨道转移燃料消耗的基本物理量，即航天器速度矢量的改变量大小。连续小推力情况下通过齐奥尔科夫斯基火箭方程由初末质量比换算。速度增量越小，转移越省燃料，是多目标交会优化的核心目标函数。
fundamentals.definition_en: The magnitude of change in a spacecraft's velocity vector, serving as the fundamental metric for fuel consumption in orbital transfers. In continuous low-thrust scenarios, it is derived from the initial and final mass ratio via the Tsiolkovsky rocket equation.
sources: 地月平动点小推力多目标交会任务设计与分析, 宇航学报, 2025

fundamentals.definition_zh: 航天器在转移全程持续开启的微小推力，推力通常为毫牛级（文中取400 mN），通过高比冲电推进发动机实现。与化学推进的脉冲式点火不同，连续小推力轨迹优化需要求解最优控制问题，决定每一时刻的推力方向和大小。
fundamentals.definition_en: A micro-newton to milli-newton level thrust continuously applied throughout a transfer trajectory using high-specific-impulse electric propulsion. Unlike impulsive chemical burns, continuous low-thrust trajectory design requires solving an optimal control problem for thrust direction and magnitude at every instant.
sources: 地月平动点小推力多目标交会任务设计与分析, 宇航学报, 2025

fundamentals.definition_zh: 发射时的目标逃逸能量（characteristic energy），定义为航天器离开地球影响范围时的双曲线超速平方。论文将地月发射C3上限设定为20 km²/s²，作为发射窗口筛选的约束条件之一。
fundamentals.definition_en: The characteristic energy at launch, defined as the square of the hyperbolic excess velocity when the spacecraft leaves Earth's sphere of influence. The paper sets the Earth-Moon launch C3 upper limit at 20 km²/s² as one of the constraints for launch window filtering.
sources: 丁百慧 等 - 2023 - 载人月球探测任务转移轨道及月面着陆区评估分析

fundamentals.definition_zh: 一种优化方法，决策变量限定为整数，目标函数和约束条件均为线性。在星座设计中，用二值变量（0或1）表示卫星是否在某个时间步处于特定位置，以最少卫星数满足覆盖需求。可用Gurobi等商业求解器高效求解。
fundamentals.definition_en: An optimization method where decision variables are restricted to integers and both the objective function and constraints are linear. In constellation design, binary variables (0 or 1) indicate whether a satellite occupies a specific position at a given time step, minimizing satellite count to meet coverage demand. Solvable efficiently by commercial solvers such as Gurobi.
sources: Patel et al., 2024, Cislunar Satellite Constellation Design via Integer Linear Programming

fundamentals.definition_zh: 将星座覆盖优化问题分解为三个层次的方法：可达性剖面描述单颗卫星对目标的可见时段，星座构型向量描述同一轨道上多颗卫星的相对相位分布，覆盖时间线由前两者循环卷积得到。三层结合后构造整数线性规划问题，求解最少卫星数的星座方案。
fundamentals.definition_en: A method that decomposes constellation coverage optimization into three layers: the accessibility profile describes when a single observer can see a target, the constellation pattern vector captures the relative phasing of multiple observers on the same orbit, and the coverage timeline is obtained by circular convolution of the two, yielding the number of available observers at each time step. These three layers combine to form an ILP that finds the minimum-satellite constellation.
sources: Lee et al., 2020, Satellite Constellation Pattern Optimization for Complex Regional Coverage
Patel et al., 2024

fundamentals.definition_zh: 星座设计问题中的约束条件，指定每个目标点在各时间步需要多少颗观测卫星同时可见。覆盖时间线必须满足或超过此需求。
fundamentals.definition_en: A constraint in the constellation design problem specifying how many observer satellites must simultaneously view each target point at each time step. The coverage timeline must meet or exceed this requirement.
sources: Patel et al., 2024

fundamentals.definition_zh: 非负整数向量，描述星座中每时刻能看到目标点的卫星数量。由可达性剖面与星座构型向量做循环卷积得到。
fundamentals.definition_en: A non-negative integer vector describing the number of constellation satellites that can view a target point at each time step. Obtained by circular convolution of the accessibility profile and the constellation pattern vector.
sources: Patel et al., 2024

fundamentals.definition_zh: 二值向量，描述同一轨道上多颗卫星相对于种子卫星的时间延迟（相位偏移）。向量中值为1的位置对应一颗卫星的相位偏移时步。
fundamentals.definition_en: A binary vector describing the time delays (phase offsets) of multiple satellites on the same orbit relative to a seed satellite. Positions with value 1 correspond to a satellite's phase offset time step.
sources: Patel et al., 2024

fundamentals.definition_zh: 同一轨道上作为相位参考基准的卫星。其他卫星的位置和相位偏移均相对于这颗卫星定义。
fundamentals.definition_en: A satellite on a given orbit that serves as the phase reference. The positions and phase offsets of all other satellites on the same orbit are defined relative to it.
sources: Patel et al., 2024

fundamentals.definition_zh: 一种运算，将两个等长序列按循环移位方式逐元素相乘再求和。在星座优化中，可达性剖面与星座构型向量的循环卷积等于覆盖时间线，其循环性质源于观测轨道的周期性。
fundamentals.definition_en: An operation that multiplies and sums elements of two equal-length sequences under cyclic shifts. In constellation optimization, the circular convolution of the accessibility profile and constellation pattern vector equals the coverage timeline; its cyclic nature arises from the periodicity of the observer orbit.
sources: Patel et al., 2024

fundamentals.definition_zh: 方阵，每列由前一列循环下移一位得到。在星座优化中，将可达性剖面的各循环移位排列成矩阵，使覆盖时间线的计算表达为矩阵与向量的乘法，便于构造整数线性规划约束。
fundamentals.definition_en: A square matrix where each column is obtained by cyclically shifting the previous column by one position. In constellation optimization, the cyclic shifts of the accessibility profile are arranged into a matrix so that coverage timeline computation becomes a matrix-vector multiplication, facilitating ILP constraint construction.
sources: Patel et al., 2024

fundamentals.definition_zh: 限制性三体问题中采用的无量纲化单位体系。距离单位（DU）取两主天体间的距离（地月系统中约 384,400 km），时间单位（TU）取使两主天体公转周期为 2π 的值（地月系统中约 375,190 s）。在规范单位下，两主天体引力参数之和为 1 DU³/TU²，使得运动方程形式简洁、便于数值计算。
fundamentals.definition_en: A nondimensional unit system used in the restricted three-body problem. The distance unit (DU) equals the distance between the two primaries (approximately 384,400 km for the Earth-Moon system), and the time unit (TU) is chosen so that the orbital period of the primaries equals 2π (approximately 375,190 s for Earth-Moon). Under canonical units the sum of the gravitational parameters of the two primaries equals 1 DU³/TU², yielding compact equations of motion.
sources: Lunar capture trajectories and homoclinic connections through isomorphic mapping (Giancotti et al., 2012)

fundamentals.definition_zh: 发射天线增益与发射功率之积（dBW），表示天线在最大辐射方向上的等效全向辐射功率。在星间链路预算中，EIRP与接收端品质因数（G/T）、自由空间损耗共同决定接收端的信号载噪比，是评估星间通信链路能否满足测距需求的核心参数。
fundamentals.definition_en: The product of transmit antenna gain and transmit power (dBW), representing the equivalent isotropic radiated power in the maximum radiation direction. In inter-satellite link budget analysis, EIRP together with receiver figure-of-merit (G/T) and free-space path loss determines the received carrier-to-noise ratio, serving as the core parameter for assessing whether the link meets ranging requirements.
sources: 蒲京辉 等 2023 3种典型地月轨道的天基定轨与时间同步

fundamentals.definition_zh: 以航天器质心为原点、固定于航天器本体的坐标系，三轴通常沿航天器主惯量轴方向。与轨道坐标系不同，本体坐标系随航天器姿态变化而旋转，用于描述航天器自身姿态和设备安装方位。在地月空间定轨中，需将设备测量方向从本体坐标系转换到惯性系。
fundamentals.definition_en: A coordinate frame fixed to the spacecraft body with its origin at the center of mass, with axes typically aligned with the spacecraft's principal inertia axes. Unlike orbital frames, it rotates with spacecraft attitude and is used for attitude description and equipment orientation. In cislunar orbit determination, measurement directions must be transformed from the body frame to the inertial frame.
sources: 蒲京辉 等 2023 3种典型地月轨道的天基定轨与时间同步

fundamentals.definition_zh: 圆形限制性三体问题旋转坐标系中的有效势函数，定义为离心势与两个主天体引力势之和。在无量纲形式下，U = (x² + y²)/2 + (1-μ)/r₁ + μ/r₂。其梯度方向为零速度时的合加速度方向，零速度曲面即由伪势函数的等值面确定。
fundamentals.definition_en: The effective potential function in the rotating frame of the CRTBP, defined as the sum of the centrifugal potential and the gravitational potentials of both primary bodies. In nondimensional form: U = (x² + y²)/2 + (1-μ)/r₁ + μ/r₂. Its gradient determines the net acceleration direction at zero velocity, and zero-velocity curves are level surfaces of the pseudopotential.
sources: Du et al. 2024

fundamentals.definition_zh: 火箭发动机喷出工质的速度，等于比冲乘以标准重力加速度（c = Isp · g₀）。在齐奥尔科夫斯基公式中，排气速度直接决定给定质量比下的速度增量大小，是发动机性能的基本参数。
fundamentals.definition_en: The velocity at which a rocket engine expels propellant, equal to the product of specific impulse and standard gravitational acceleration (c = Isp · g₀). In the Tsiolkovsky rocket equation, exhaust velocity directly determines the velocity increment for a given mass ratio, making it a fundamental engine performance parameter.
sources: Du et al. 2024

fundamentals.definition_zh: 控制发动机实际推力与最大推力之比的无量纲参数，取值范围 [0, 1]。在时间最优控制中，节流参数恒为 1；在燃料最优控制中，节流参数随时间变化，由切换函数决定发动机的开关状态。
fundamentals.definition_en: A dimensionless parameter controlling the ratio of actual thrust to maximum thrust, constrained within [0, 1]. In time-optimal control, the throttle parameter is always 1; in fuel-optimal control, it varies over time, with the switching function determining engine on/off states.
sources: Du et al. 2024

fundamentals.definition_zh: 月球绕地公转轨道的偏心率（约0.0549），使地月距离在近地点和远地点之间变化。在高保真星历模型中，月球轨道偏心率对转移时间和转移代价有显著影响：不同出发时刻的转移性能差异明显，某些特定出发日期的转移轨道可优于圆型限制性三体问题中的标称结果。
fundamentals.definition_en: The eccentricity of the Moon's orbit around the Earth (approximately 0.0549). In high-fidelity ephemeris models, lunar orbit eccentricity significantly affects transfer time and cost; transfers departing at specific epochs can outperform nominal CR3BP results.
sources: Wang et al. 2021

fundamentals.zh: 本地垂线本地水平坐标系
fundamentals.definition_zh: 以目标飞行器为参考定义的本地坐标系，R-bar指向主天体，H-bar垂直于轨道面，V-bar构成右手系。
fundamentals.definition_en: A local reference frame defined with respect to the target spacecraft, with R-bar pointing to the primary body, H-bar perpendicular to the orbital plane, and V-bar completing the right-handed system.
sources: Bucchioni和Innocenti 2021

fundamentals.definition_zh: 随两天体系统质心旋转的参考坐标系，x轴从主天体指向第二天体，z轴垂直于轨道面。
fundamentals.definition_en: A co-rotating reference frame with origin at the barycenter, x-axis pointing from the primary to the secondary body, z-axis normal to the orbital plane.
sources: Bucchioni和Innocenti 2021

fundamentals.definition_zh: 坐标轴指向固定的惯性参考方向（如JPL DE200星历定义的春分点方向）的坐标系。
fundamentals.definition_en: A coordinate frame with axes aligned with fixed inertial directions such as the vernal equinox as defined by JPL DE200 ephemeris.
sources: Bucchioni和Innocenti 2021

fundamentals.definition_zh: 航天器沿轨迹从出发点到到达点所经历的时间长度，通常以天为单位。在转移轨道设计中，飞行时间与燃料消耗（总 Δv）是相互制约的两个主要指标：缩短飞行时间通常需要更多燃料，节省燃料则飞行时间较长。
fundamentals.definition_en: The duration a spacecraft spends traveling from departure to arrival along a trajectory, typically measured in days. In transfer trajectory design, TOF and propellant cost (total Δv) are two primary competing objectives: shorter TOF generally requires more propellant, while propellant savings extend TOF.
sources: Bucchioni和Innocenti 2021
Zimovan-Spreen et al. 2022

fundamentals.definition_zh: 描述轨道机动所需速度变化量的指标，反映任务燃料消耗。
fundamentals.definition_en: A measure of the velocity change required for an orbital maneuver, reflecting mission fuel expenditure.
sources: Bucchioni和Innocenti 2021

fundamentals.definition_zh: 描述椭圆轨道位置的辅助角度，在近心点处为零。定义为从椭圆中心看，真近点角对应的辅助圆上的角度。通过偏近点角可建立位置与时间的关系，是开普勒方程中的核心变量。
fundamentals.definition_en: An auxiliary angle describing position in an elliptical orbit, zero at periapsis. Defined as the angle on the auxiliary circle corresponding to the true anomaly when viewed from the ellipse center. It establishes the relationship between position and time and is the core variable in Kepler's equation.
sources: Bucchioni和Innocenti 2021
肖业伦和韩潮 - 2006 - 航天器动力学
轨道力学 第3章
Vallado - 2022 - Fundamentals of astrodynamics and applications

fundamentals.definition_zh: 利用新量测信息修正先验概率分布以获得后验分布的统计推断方法。核心公式为后验正比于先验与似然函数的乘积。在非合作目标搜索中，目标未被观测到这一「负面信息」同样用于贝叶斯更新：通过收缩可达域的范围，逐步缩小搜索空间。
fundamentals.definition_en: A statistical inference method that uses new measurement information to correct the prior probability distribution and obtain the posterior. The core formula states that the posterior is proportional to the product of the prior and the likelihood function. In non-cooperative target search, the negative information from failing to detect a target is also used in Bayesian update to progressively shrink the reachable domain and search scope.
sources: Li 等 - 2025 - Efficient reachable domain search-tracking for cislunar non-cooperative targets via designed quadrature

fundamentals.definition_zh: 消耗推进剂质量与航天器初始质量的比值，用于衡量轨道转移的燃料经济性，低推力内部转移约10%，一次冲量外部转移约66%。
fundamentals.definition_en: The ratio of consumed propellant mass to the initial mass of the spacecraft, used to assess the fuel efficiency of an orbital transfer. Low-thrust interior transfers achieve around 10%, while single-impulse exterior transfers around 66%.
sources: Mingotti et al., 2012, Transfers to distant periodic orbits around the Moon via their invariant manifolds

fundamentals.definition_zh: 推力小但比冲高的推进方式，典型如电推进，比冲约3000秒，可长时间持续加速，用于低能量转移。
fundamentals.definition_en: Propulsion with low thrust but high specific impulse, typically electric propulsion with specific impulse around 3000 s, capable of continuous acceleration over long durations for low-energy transfers.
sources: Mingotti et al., 2012, Transfers to distant periodic orbits around the Moon via their invariant manifolds

fundamentals.definition_zh: 地月三体系统中，平动点附近区域的引力场不具备对称性。这种不对称性使轨道具有唯一确定的尺寸、形状和绝对朝向，是LiAISON导航方法实现自主定轨的物理基础。
fundamentals.definition_en: The gravitational field near libration points in the Earth-Moon three-body system lacks symmetry. This asymmetry endows orbits with unique size, shape, and absolute orientation, forming the physical basis of the LiAISON autonomous orbit determination method.

fundamentals.definition_zh: 由GRACE和GOCE卫星数据联合解算的地球重力场模型，截断至20阶20次。用于高精度轨道预报中地球非球形引力摄动的计算。
fundamentals.definition_en: An Earth gravity field model jointly derived from GRACE and GOCE satellite data, truncated to degree and order 20. Used for computing Earth's non-spherical gravitational perturbation in high-precision orbit propagation.

fundamentals.definition_zh: 由GRAIL月球探测器数据解算的月球重力场模型，截断至20阶20次。用于轨道预报中月球非球形引力摄动的计算。
fundamentals.definition_en: A lunar gravity field model derived from GRAIL probe data, truncated to degree and order 20. Used for computing lunar non-spherical gravitational perturbation in orbit propagation.

fundamentals.definition_zh: 喷气推进实验室（JPL）发布的行星和月球精密历表，提供太阳系各天体的位置和速度。相比DE405和DE421，DE430纳入了GRAIL月球重力数据和月面激光测距数据。
fundamentals.definition_en: A precision planetary and lunar ephemeris published by JPL, providing positions and velocities of solar system bodies. Compared to DE405 and DE421, DE430 incorporates GRAIL lunar gravity data and lunar laser ranging measurements.

fundamentals.definition_zh: 在轨道交会问题中，从追踪航天器到目标航天器的中心角（以中心天体为顶点）。对于共面圆轨道间的运动目标交会，该角随目标运动而持续变化，其大小直接决定速度增量消耗。分离角为零或360度整数倍时，消耗最低。
fundamentals.definition_en: In orbital rendezvous problems, the central angle measured from the chaser spacecraft to the target spacecraft (with the primary body at the vertex). For moving-target rendezvous between coplanar circular orbits, this angle changes continuously as the target moves, and its magnitude directly determines the velocity increment cost. The cost is minimized when the separation angle equals zero or an integer multiple of 360 degrees.
sources: Shen和Tsiotras - 2003 - Optimal two-impulse rendezvous using multiple-revolution lambert solutions

fundamentals.definition_zh: 以参考圆轨道上航天器为原点的相对运动坐标系。x轴指向径向（远离中心天体为正），y轴沿速度方向，z轴垂直轨道平面。该坐标系为Clohessy-Wiltshire方程提供参考框架，是近距交会对接分析的基础。当两航天器距离远小于轨道半径时，相对运动可用线性化CW方程描述。
fundamentals.definition_en: A relative motion coordinate frame centered on a spacecraft in a reference circular orbit. The x-axis points along the radial direction (positive away from the primary body), the y-axis along the velocity direction, and the z-axis is normal to the orbital plane. This frame provides the reference for the Clohessy-Wiltshire equations and is the foundation for proximity rendezvous and docking analysis. When the separation between two spacecraft is much smaller than the orbital radius, relative motion can be described by the linearized C-W equations.
sources: Shen和Tsiotras - 2003 - Optimal two-impulse rendezvous using multiple-revolution lambert solutions

fundamentals.definition_zh: 圆形限制性三体问题中，将离心力势和两个主天体引力势合并得到的标量函数。表达式为 U = (x² + y²)/2 + (1-μ)/d₁ + μ/d₂，其中 d₁、d₂ 分别为质点到两个主天体的距离。五个平动点即为该函数的驻点，零速度曲面由 U 的等值线决定。
fundamentals.definition_en: In the CR3BP, a scalar function combining the centrifugal potential with the gravitational potentials of two primary bodies: U = (x² + y²)/2 + (1-μ)/d₁ + μ/d₂, where d₁ and d₂ are distances to each primary. The five Lagrange points are stationary points of this function, and zero-velocity curves are level sets of U.
sources: Zimovan-Spreen et al. 2022

fundamentals.definition_zh: 描述遮挡天体（地球或月球）遮挡太阳光所形成的几何阴影的数学模型。由本影锥（umbra，完全遮挡区）和半影锥（penumbra，部分遮挡区）组成，其尺寸由太阳半径、遮挡天体半径以及两者之间的距离共同决定。论文采用此模型计算轨道上的阴影穿越情况，用于日食规避约束的几何基础。
fundamentals.definition_en: A mathematical model describing the geometric shadow cast by an occluding body (Earth or Moon) blocking sunlight. Composed of the umbra cone (total shadow) and penumbra cone (partial shadow), its dimensions are determined by the radii of the Sun and the occluding body and the distance between them. The paper employs this model to compute shadow passages along trajectories, forming the geometric basis for the eclipse avoidance constraint.
sources: Zimovan-Spreen et al. 2022

fundamentals.definition_zh: 遮挡天体阴影的外层部分，其中只有部分太阳圆面被遮挡。与本影（完全遮挡）不同，半影区内航天器仍能接收部分太阳光。在日食规避设计中，通常将航天器保持在半影之外即可满足热控和电源约束。半影的几何边界由遮挡天体半径、太阳半径和三者相对位置共同确定。
fundamentals.definition_en: The outer portion of an occluding body's shadow where only part of the solar disk is blocked. Unlike the umbra (total shadow), a spacecraft in the penumbra still receives partial sunlight. In eclipse avoidance design, keeping the spacecraft outside the penumbra generally satisfies thermal and power constraints. The penumbra boundary is defined by the occluding body radius, solar radius, and relative geometry of the three bodies.
sources: Zimovan-Spreen et al. 2022
Spreen 2021

fundamentals.definition_zh: 天体引力主导的近似范围，半径约为该天体到主天体距离乘以质量比的立方根。地月系中月球的希尔球半径约6万公里。在此范围内，航天器主要受月球引力控制，可用月心二体动力学近似分析飞越轨道，为动力飞越的初步筛选提供简化模型。
fundamentals.definition_en: The approximate region where a celestial body's gravity dominates, with a radius approximately equal to its distance from the primary multiplied by the cube root of the mass ratio. The Moon's Hill sphere in the Earth-Moon system has a radius of about 60,000 km. Within this region, a spacecraft is primarily governed by the Moon's gravity, allowing two-body selenocentric dynamics to approximate flyby trajectories, providing a simplified model for preliminary flyby analysis.
sources: Peng et al. 2024, AIAA Journal of Spacecraft and Rockets, doi:10.2514/1.A35623

fundamentals.definition_zh: 以地月系统质心为原点、x轴从地球指向月球、与地月公转角速度同步旋转的参考系。地月在x轴上固定不动，平动点和周期轨道在此坐标系中呈现为静止或准周期的几何曲线，是分析转移轨道空间构型的基本工具。
fundamentals.definition_en: A reference frame with its origin at the Earth-Moon barycenter, x-axis directed from Earth to Moon, rotating synchronously with the Earth-Moon orbital angular velocity. Earth and Moon are fixed on the x-axis, and libration points and periodic orbits appear as stationary or quasi-periodic geometric curves. This frame is the fundamental tool for analyzing the spatial geometry of transfer trajectories.
sources: Peng et al. 2024, AIAA Journal of Spacecraft and Rockets, doi:10.2514/1.A35623

fundamentals.definition_zh: 以远月点为原点的局部轨道坐标系。径向轴从地心指向远月点，法向轴沿轨道角动量方向（位置矢量与速度矢量的叉积），横向轴由右手定则确定。在该坐标系中可将速度脉冲分解为改变轨道面内形状和改变轨道面外方向的两个独立分量，便于参数化搜索。
fundamentals.definition_en: A local orbital coordinate frame centered at the apogee. The radial axis points from Earth's center to the apogee, the normal axis aligns with the orbital angular momentum (cross product of position and velocity vectors), and the cross-track axis completes the right-handed triad. In this frame, velocity impulses are decomposed into independent in-plane and out-of-plane components, facilitating parameterized search.
sources: Peng et al. 2024, AIAA Journal of Spacecraft and Rockets, doi:10.2514/1.A35623

fundamentals.definition_zh: 一种改进的赤道轨道根数，消除了经典根数在零偏心率和0°、90°轨道倾角时的奇异性，并避免了半通径在偏心率等于1时的间断。定义包括半通径p、径向分量f和g、横向分量h和k以及真近点角L。该表示法在低推力轨迹优化中便于将扰动加速度与中心引力分离。
fundamentals.definition_en: A modified set of equinoctial orbit elements that eliminates singularities in classical elements at zero eccentricity and inclinations of 0° and 90°, and avoids discontinuities in semiparameter when eccentricity equals one. The formulation includes semiparameter p, radial components f and g, transverse components h and k, and true longitude L. This representation facilitates separation of disturbing acceleration from central gravitational acceleration in low-thrust trajectory optimization.
sources: Betts and Erb, 2003, Optimal low thrust trajectories to the moon

fundamentals.definition_zh: 以月球质量中心为原点、跟随月球在空间中运动的参考坐标系。月球Z轴垂直于月轨平面，X轴沿月轨与赤道面交线方向，Y轴按右手系确定。在地月转移的第三阶段（绕月滑行阶段），航天器动力学从地心坐标系切换到月心坐标系进行分析。
fundamentals.definition_en: A reference frame centered at the Moon's center of mass that follows the Moon's motion in space. The lunar Z-axis is perpendicular to the lunar orbital plane, the X-axis is along the intersection of the lunar orbit with the equatorial plane, and the Y-axis is defined by the right-hand rule. In the third phase of Earth-Moon transfer (selenocentric coast phase), spacecraft dynamics switch from geocentric to selenocentric frame for analysis.
sources: Betts and Erb, 2003, Optimal low thrust trajectories to the moon

fundamentals.definition_zh: 一种电推进装置，利用电场加速等离子体产生推力。文中PPS-1350霍尔推力器是SMART-1任务采用的太阳电推进系统，推力73.19 mN，比冲16.434 km/s。霍尔推力器属于稳态等离子体推进，推力密度高、结构简单。
fundamentals.definition_en: An electric propulsion device that uses electric fields to accelerate plasma to generate thrust. The PPS-1350 Hall thruster used in the SMART-1 mission is a solar electric propulsion system with thrust 73.19 mN and specific impulse 16.434 km/s. Hall thrusters are steady-state plasma propulsion devices with high thrust density and simple structure.
sources: Betts and Erb, 2003, Optimal low thrust trajectories to the moon

fundamentals.definition_zh: 表征观测值对待估状态敏感程度的矩阵。在离散非线性系统中，由状态转移矩阵和设计矩阵计算得到。矩阵可逆则系统可观测，其最小特征值和条件数分别用于评估可观测性程度。
fundamentals.definition_en: A matrix characterizing the sensitivity of observations to estimated states. In discrete nonlinear systems, it is computed from the state transition matrix and design matrix. If the matrix is invertible, the system is observable; its minimum eigenvalue and condition number assess the degree of observability.
sources: 地月空间DRO近距离编队星间测量相对定轨

fundamentals.definition_zh: 格兰姆矩阵最大特征值与最小特征值之比。条件数过大意味着一个待估状态的微小变化所引起的测量输出会掩盖另一个待估状态的变化。一般认为小于10的16次方时系统可观测性较好。
fundamentals.definition_en: The ratio of the maximum to minimum eigenvalues of the Gramian matrix. A large condition number means measurement outputs from small changes in one estimated state can mask changes in another state. Generally, values below 10^16 indicate adequate observability.
sources: 地月空间DRO近距离编队星间测量相对定轨

fundamentals.definition_zh: 格兰姆矩阵的最小特征值。用于衡量系统的可观测程度，大于10的负3次方时表示系统可观测性较好。与具体估计方法或过程无关。
fundamentals.definition_en: The minimum eigenvalue of the Gramian matrix. Used to measure the degree of system observability; values above 10^-3 indicate good observability. Independent of the specific estimation method or process.
sources: 地月空间DRO近距离编队星间测量相对定轨

fundamentals.definition_zh: 从几何测量上能够唯一确定待估参数状态的测量组合。在DRO近距离编队中，星间测距结合光学测角或测距结合测角测速属于完备测量，可较快收敛到高精度。
fundamentals.definition_en: A measurement combination that can uniquely determine the estimated parameter states from geometric measurements. In DRO close formations, inter-satellite ranging combined with optical angle measurement, or ranging combined with angle and velocity measurement, constitutes complete measurement and converges rapidly to high accuracy.
sources: 地月空间DRO近距离编队星间测量相对定轨

fundamentals.definition_zh: 无法从几何测量上唯一确定待估参数状态的测量组合。在DRO近距离编队中，仅测距或仅测距测速属于非完备测量，可观测性差，收敛时间长且对初值敏感。
fundamentals.definition_en: A measurement combination that cannot uniquely determine the estimated parameter states from geometric measurements. In DRO close formations, ranging-only or ranging-plus-velocity-only measurements are incomplete, with poor observability, long convergence times, and sensitivity to initial values.
sources: 地月空间DRO近距离编队星间测量相对定轨

fundamentals.definition_zh: 卡尔曼滤波中测量模型对待估状态的偏导数矩阵，描述测量值对状态变化的敏感程度。在EKF测量更新中用于计算卡尔曼增益和更新状态协方差。
fundamentals.definition_en: In Kalman filtering, the partial derivative matrix of the measurement model with respect to the estimated state, describing the sensitivity of measurements to state changes. Used in EKF measurement update to compute the Kalman gain and update the state covariance.
sources: 地月空间DRO近距离编队星间测量相对定轨

fundamentals.definition_zh: 测量数据中的随机误差，建模为高斯白噪声。在星间测距链路中由热噪声主导，噪声标准差决定了测量精度，直接影响定轨收敛速度和精度。
fundamentals.definition_en: Random errors in measurement data, modeled as Gaussian white noise. Dominated by thermal noise in inter-satellite ranging links. The noise standard deviation determines measurement accuracy and directly affects orbit determination convergence speed and accuracy.
sources: 地月空间DRO近距离编队星间测量相对定轨

fundamentals.definition_zh: 将非直接测量的信息（如先验相对轨道）作为约束条件引入滤波器的虚拟测量量。其设计矩阵为单位矩阵，通过调节噪声权重控制约束强度。
fundamentals.definition_en: Virtual measurement quantities introduced into the filter as constraints using non-direct measurement information (such as prior relative orbits). Their design matrix is an identity matrix, with constraint strength controlled by adjusting noise weights.
sources: 地月空间DRO近距离编队星间测量相对定轨

fundamentals.definition_zh: 从观测卫星指向目标卫星的单位矢量，由两颗卫星的位置矢量之差除以其模得到。是星间测距和测角模型的基础几何量。
fundamentals.definition_en: The unit vector from the observing satellite to the target satellite, obtained by dividing the difference of their position vectors by its magnitude. A fundamental geometric quantity for inter-satellite ranging and angle measurement models.
sources: 地月空间DRO近距离编队星间测量相对定轨

fundamentals.definition_zh: 视线矢量与参考平面（如xy平面）之间的夹角。在光学测角模型中，由目标与观测者的z轴坐标差和视线距离计算得到。
fundamentals.definition_en: The angle between the line-of-sight vector and a reference plane (such as the xy-plane). In optical angle measurement models, computed from the z-axis coordinate difference and the line-of-sight distance between target and observer.
sources: 地月空间DRO近距离编队星间测量相对定轨

fundamentals.definition_zh: 通过多次随机采样进行统计分析的数值仿真方法。在相对定轨研究中用于评估定轨精度和收敛时间的统计特性。
fundamentals.definition_en: A numerical simulation method that performs statistical analysis through repeated random sampling. Used in relative orbit determination research to evaluate statistical properties of orbit determination accuracy and convergence time.
sources: 地月空间DRO近距离编队星间测量相对定轨

fundamentals.definition_zh: 圆型限制性三体问题旋转坐标系中，引力势能与旋转离心势之和。决定零速度曲面的形状和航天器在旋转系中的运动范围。
fundamentals.definition_en: In the rotating frame of the circular restricted three-body problem, the sum of gravitational potential energy and the rotational centrifugal potential. It determines the shape of zero-velocity surfaces and the accessible region of the spacecraft in the rotating frame.
sources: 地月远距离逆行轨道脉冲调相方法

fundamentals.definition_zh: 以航天器当前位置为原点，速度方向和其垂直方向为基底的局部坐标系。用于将脉冲机动分解为沿速度方向和法向的分量，便于描述和优化机动方向。
fundamentals.definition_en: A local coordinate system centered at the spacecraft's current position, using the velocity direction and its perpendicular as basis vectors. Used to decompose impulsive maneuvers into along-track and normal components for convenient description and optimization of maneuver direction.
sources: 地月远距离逆行轨道脉冲调相方法

fundamentals.definition_zh: 圆型限制性三体问题旋转坐标系中的有效势函数U。它由两个主天体的引力势和离心势三部分组成，满足 U = (1-μ)/r1 + μ/r2 + (x²+y²)/2。伪势的梯度决定了运动方程中的科里奥利力以外的加速度项，其等值面构成零速度曲面。
fundamentals.definition_en: The effective potential function U in the rotating frame of the circular restricted three-body problem. Comprising gravitational potentials of both primaries and the centrifugal potential, it governs the non-Coriolis accelerations and its level surfaces form the zero-velocity surfaces.
sources: Renk et al., 2010, Exploration missions in the Sun-Earth-Moon system

fundamentals.definition_zh: 以月球为中心天体的轨道上距月球最近的拱点，类比近地轨道的近地点（perigee）。在月球飞越转移中，近月点的高度决定了引力辅助的效果和后续转移弧段的能量。
fundamentals.definition_en: The periapsis of a Moon-centered orbit, i.e., the point of closest approach to the lunar surface. Analogous to perigee for Earth-centered orbits. Its altitude governs the effectiveness of the lunar gravity assist.
sources: Renk et al., 2010, Exploration missions in the Sun-Earth-Moon system
Sanna等 - 2024

fundamentals.definition_zh: Miele在1960年证明的CRTBP对称性质：若一条地月轨迹在旋转坐标系中的状态为(x, y, z, xdot, ydot, zdot, t)，则(x, -y, z, -xdot, ydot, -zdot, -t)也是一条合法轨迹。该定理意味着地月转移和月地转移可互为镜像，无需分别计算。
fundamentals.definition_en: A symmetry property of the CRTBP proved by Miele (1960): if (x, y, z, xdot, ydot, zdot, t) is a solution, then (x, -y, z, -xdot, ydot, -zdot, -t) is also a solution. Earth-moon and moon-Earth transfers are mirror images, eliminating the need to compute them separately.
sources: Miele, 1960, Astronautica Acta; Anderson and Parker, 2012

fundamentals.definition_zh: 速度矢量与当地水平面之间的夹角。在月面着陆场景中，飞行路径角决定了着陆轨迹的陡峭程度：垂直撞击对应90度，掠射对应接近0度。该参数直接影响着陆器的热防护和制导需求。
fundamentals.definition_en: The angle between the velocity vector and the local horizontal plane. For lunar landing, the FPA determines trajectory steepness: a vertical impact is 90 deg while a grazing approach is near 0 deg. It directly affects thermal protection and guidance requirements.
sources: Anderson and Parker, 2012, J. Guidance, Control, and Dynamics

fundamentals.definition_zh: 轨迹到达天体表面时速度矢量与表面法线之间的夹角。垂直撞击的入射角为0度（法线方向），掠射为接近90度。LCROSS任务选择4度入射角（相对于法线86度相对于表面）以确保科学观测效果。
fundamentals.definition_en: The angle between the velocity vector and the surface normal as a trajectory reaches a celestial body's surface. A vertical impact has 0 deg impact angle; the LCROSS mission used 4 deg (86 deg from the surface) for scientific objectives.
sources: Anderson and Parker, 2012, J. Guidance, Control, and Dynamics

fundamentals.definition_zh: 包含太阳、地球和月球引力的完整力学模型。与地月CRTBP相比，日地月系统引入太阳作为第四体摄动源，产生大量仅靠地月引力无法实现的新转移轨迹。这些轨迹利用日地平动点动力学或太阳引力辅助，可在较低速度增量下完成地月转移。
fundamentals.definition_en: The full dynamical model including gravitational effects of the sun, Earth, and moon. Compared to the Earth-moon CRTBP, it introduces the sun as a fourth-body perturbation source, producing transfer trajectories that exploit sun-Earth libration point dynamics or solar gravity to reduce delta-V.
sources: Anderson and Parker, 2012, J. Guidance, Control, and Dynamics
Ul Haq 等 - 2026

fundamentals.definition_zh: 一种自适应常微分方程数值积分方法，通过动态调整多项式阶数来平衡精度和计算效率。本文使用的DIVA积分器属于此类方法，积分容差设为1e-12，适用于星历模型中长时间高精度轨道传播。
fundamentals.definition_en: A numerical ODE integration method that dynamically adjusts polynomial order to balance accuracy and efficiency. The DIVA integrator used in this study belongs to this class, with a tolerance of 1e-12, suitable for long-duration high-precision propagation in ephemeris models.
sources: Anderson and Parker, 2012, J. Guidance, Control, and Dynamics

fundamentals.definition_zh: 描述太阳系天体（含月球）随时间变化的位置和速度的高精度数值数据表。本文使用JPL DE421星历表，由NASA喷气推进实验室维护。星历模型比CRTBP更贴近实际，能捕获月球轨道偏心率、倾角以及太阳等其他天体的摄动效应。
fundamentals.definition_en: A high-precision numerical dataset describing the positions and velocities of solar system bodies (including the moon) over time. This study uses JPL DE421, maintained by NASA/JPL. The ephemeris model captures lunar orbital eccentricity, inclination, and perturbations from bodies like the sun.
sources: Folkner et al., 2008, JPL IOM; Anderson and Parker, 2012

fundamentals.definition_zh: 以两天体质心为原点、随系统转动的参考坐标系，用于描述限制性三体问题中航天器的运动。
fundamentals.definition_en: A rotating reference frame centered at the barycenter of the two primaries, used to describe the motion of a small body in the restricted three-body problem.
sources: Liu 等 - 2014 - Application of two special orbits in the orbit determination of lunar satellites

fundamentals.definition_zh: 以月球中心为原点、以月球赤道面为基准面的参考坐标系，用于真实力模型中的轨道积分和定轨计算。
fundamentals.definition_en: A reference frame centered at the Moon with the lunar equatorial plane as the reference, used for orbit integration and determination in the real force model.
sources: Liu 等 - 2014 - Application of two special orbits in the orbit determination of lunar satellites

fundamentals.definition_zh: 月球引力场的标量势函数，用勒让德多项式展开为带谐项（与经度无关的轴对称分量）和田谐/扇谐项（与经度相关的非对称分量）之和。展开系数由月球探测器（如月球勘测者号）的跟踪数据反演得到。
fundamentals.definition_en: The scalar potential function of the Moon's gravitational field, expanded in Legendre polynomials into zonal harmonics (longitude-independent axially symmetric components) and tesseral/sectoral harmonics (longitude-dependent asymmetric components). The expansion coefficients are derived from tracking data of lunar probes such as Lunar Prospector.
sources: Sanna et al., 2024, Aerospace 11, 460

fundamentals.definition_zh: 月球引力位展开中仅与纬度有关、不依赖经度的系数项，记为 J_l。带谐项反映月球质量分布沿南北方向的不均匀性，其中 J_2 项最大，代表月球的扁率效应。
fundamentals.definition_en: Coefficients in the lunar gravitational potential expansion that depend only on latitude, not longitude, denoted J_l. Zonal terms represent north-south asymmetries in the Moon's mass distribution; the J_2 term, the largest, captures the lunar oblateness effect.
sources: Sanna et al., 2024, Aerospace 11, 460

fundamentals.definition_zh: 由月球勘测者号（Lunar Prospector）任务数据建立的月球重力场模型，提供带谐、田谐和扇谐系数至 100 阶次。系数绝对值大于 5×10⁻⁶ 的项被认为对轨道运动有实际影响。
fundamentals.definition_en: A lunar gravity field model derived from Lunar Prospector mission data, providing zonal, tesseral, and sectoral harmonic coefficients up to degree and order 100. Terms with coefficients exceeding |J_lm| > 5×10⁻⁶ are considered to have a practical effect on orbital motion.
sources: Konopliv et al., 2001, Icarus 150, 1-18; Sanna et al., 2024, Aerospace 11, 460

fundamentals.definition_zh: 月球产生的引力场，因其内部质量分布不均匀而偏离简单的中心引力场。通过球谐函数展开来描述，系数越高阶越反映局部细节。在低月球轨道附近，高阶引力场系数对轨道演化的影响显著。
fundamentals.definition_en: The gravitational field generated by the Moon, which deviates from a simple central field due to non-uniform internal mass distribution. Described through spherical harmonic expansions, with higher-degree coefficients capturing finer spatial details. Near low lunar orbits, high-degree gravity terms significantly affect orbital evolution.
sources: Sanna et al., 2024, Aerospace 11, 460

fundamentals.definition_zh: 描述太阳辐射压对航天器加速度影响大小的无量纲参数，定义为反射面法向加速度与太阳局部引力场加速度之比。在 1 AU 处，光度参数 lambda 等于特征加速度除以约 5.93 乘以 10 的负 3 次方米每二次方秒。该参数越大，太阳帆或高面质比航天器受光压影响越显著。
fundamentals.definition_en: A dimensionless parameter quantifying the effect of solar radiation pressure on a spacecraft, defined as the ratio of the acceleration experienced by a reflective surface normal to the sun line to the Sun's local gravitational acceleration. At 1 AU, lambda equals the characteristic acceleration divided by approximately 5.93e-3 m/s^2. A higher lightness number indicates greater influence of solar radiation pressure, as relevant for solar sails or high area-to-mass ratio spacecraft.
sources: Van Der Weg and Vasile, 2016
Dachwald et al., 2002

fundamentals.definition_zh: 一种状态转移张量的短时插值方法。利用变分方程幂级数解的结构，对 STM 和 STT 的每个分量乘以不同的 alpha 幂次而非统一的线性插值。幂次由动力学系统 Jacobian 矩阵各元素首次非零的幂次决定。该方法运算量与逐元线性插值相当，但对大部分分量能达到更高阶精度。
fundamentals.definition_en: A short-time interpolation scheme for state transition tensors that assigns different powers of the interpolation parameter alpha to each entry of the STM and STT, rather than uniform linear interpolation. The power for each entry is determined by the first nonzero power of the Jacobian matrix for that element. It achieves the same operation count as entrywise linear interpolation but with higher-order accuracy for most entries.
sources: Kulik et al., 2023, JGCD, doi:10.2514/1.G007311

fundamentals.definition_zh: 围绕参考轨道预先积分变分方程并存储状态转移矩阵和张量的策略。将参考轨道的时间区间按 2^m 等分，在每个子区间上积分一阶和二阶变分方程，存储对应的 STM 和 STT。在线阶段通过 cocycle 性质拼接预计算数据，避免每次求解最优控制问题时都进行数值积分。
fundamentals.definition_en: A strategy of precomputing and storing state transition matrices and tensors by integrating variational equations around a reference trajectory. The time span is divided into 2^m equal intervals, on each of which first- and second-order variational equations are integrated and stored. During the online phase, cocycle conditions compose the precomputed data, avoiding numerical integration for each new optimal control problem.
sources: Kulik et al., 2023, JGCD, doi:10.2514/1.G007311

fundamentals.definition_zh: 一阶 cocycle 条件在二阶状态转移张量上的推广。允许将长时间区间的二阶 STT 拆分为两个子区间上 STM 和 STT 的乘积组合。是预计算插值算法的数学基础，使得从存储的子区间数据拼接出任意时间段的 STT 成为可能。
fundamentals.definition_en: The second-order generalization of the cocycle property for state transition tensors. It allows the second-order STT over a long time interval to be decomposed into products of STMs and STTs over two subintervals. This provides the mathematical basis for the precomputation and interpolation algorithm, enabling STT composition from stored subinterval data.
sources: Kulik et al., 2023, JGCD, doi:10.2514/1.G007311

fundamentals.definition_zh: 将状态、协态和性能指标合并为一个向量 z = [x^T, lambda^T, J]^T，使最优控制问题的动力学变为单一方程组。对该增广系统建立变分方程，即可用 STM 和 STT 同时描述状态、协态和能量代价对初始扰动的灵敏度。可进一步将偏心率等物理参数作为零时间导数的状态变量加入增广向量。
fundamentals.definition_en: A composite vector z = [x^T, lambda^T, J]^T that combines states, costates, and the performance metric into a single augmented dynamical system. Variational equations applied to this system yield STM and STT that simultaneously describe sensitivities of states, costates, and energy cost. Physical parameters such as eccentricity can be included as state variables with zero time derivatives.
sources: Kulik et al., 2023, JGCD, doi:10.2514/1.G007311

fundamentals.definition_zh: 通过求解 Hamilton 正则方程的两点边值问题来获得最优控制的方法。基于庞特里亚金极值原理，将最优控制问题转化为对协态变量初值的求解。本文将变分方程应用于间接方法，通过预计算 STM 和 STT 来避免反复数值积分打靶。
fundamentals.definition_en: An approach to optimal control that solves a two-point boundary value problem of Hamilton's canonical equations. Based on Pontryagin's maximum principle, it converts the optimal control problem into finding initial costate values. In this work, variational equations are applied to the indirect method, using precomputed STM and STT to avoid repeated numerical shooting.
sources: Kulik et al., 2023, JGCD, doi:10.2514/1.G007311

fundamentals.definition_zh: 在三体动力学中，控制伴随卫星相对于参考卫星的相对状态转移问题。给定参考轨道附近的初始相对状态 delta_x_0 和终端相对状态 delta_x_f，通过变分方程求解最优协态变量初值 delta_lambda_0。本文方法使任意边界条件的相对最优控制问题可在 O(m*n^3) 操作内近似求解。
fundamentals.definition_en: The problem of controlling a deputy satellite's relative state transfer with respect to a chief satellite under three-body dynamics. Given initial relative state delta_x_0 and final relative state delta_x_f near a reference orbit, the optimal initial costates delta_lambda_0 are solved via variational equations. The method enables approximate solution of any relative optimal control problem with arbitrary boundary conditions in O(m*n^3) operations.
sources: Kulik et al., 2023, JGCD, doi:10.2514/1.G007311

fundamentals.definition_zh: 将偏心率作为增广状态变量，利用二阶 STT 评估圆型限制性三体问题（CR3BP）近似在椭圆三体问题（ER3BP）中的有效性的方法。结果表明，对日地 Halo 轨道附近的相对运动，CR3BP 模型的最优控制代价误差不超过 1%，验证了低保真度模型用于方案比较的合理性。
fundamentals.definition_en: A method that treats eccentricity as an augmented state variable and uses second-order STT to evaluate the validity of the CR3BP approximation in the elliptical restricted three-body problem (ER3BP). Results show that for relative motion near Sun-Earth Halo orbits, the CR3BP model's optimal control cost error is within 1%, validating the use of the low-fidelity model for comparative analysis.
sources: Kulik et al., 2023, JGCD, doi:10.2514/1.G007311

fundamentals.definition_zh: 预计算变分数据的存储结构。将参考轨道的时间区间等分为 2^m 份，从最细粒度（第 m 层）向上逐层利用 cocycle 条件合并子区间数据，形成 m+1 个层次的 STM 和 STT 数据。在线阶段按二分查找策略，从最粗层开始逐层拼接，仅需 O(m) 次矩阵乘法即可得到目标区间的 STT。
fundamentals.definition_en: A hierarchical storage structure for precomputed variational data. The reference orbit's time span is divided into 2^m equal intervals, and cocycle conditions are applied upward from the finest level (m) to form m+1 levels of STM and STT data. During the online phase, a binary search strategy composes data from coarsest to finest, requiring only O(m) matrix multiplications to obtain STTs for any target interval.
sources: Kulik et al., 2023, JGCD, doi:10.2514/1.G007311

fundamentals.definition_zh: 在圆型限制性三体问题（CRTBP）中，为消除数值计算中的量级差异而定义的一组无量纲单位。距离单位 DU 等于两天体间距 R，时间单位 TU 等于系统角速度的倒数 ω⁻¹，质量单位 MU 取航天器初始质量 m₀，力单位 FU = MU·DU/TU²。在此无量纲化下，CRTBP 方程仅含系统质量比 μ 这一个参数，数值计算的量级统一，有利于优化算法的收敛性。
fundamentals.definition_en: A set of nondimensional units defined in the circular restricted three-body problem (CRTBP) to eliminate numerical scale disparities. The distance unit (DU) equals the primary separation R, the time unit (TU) equals the inverse angular velocity ω⁻¹, the mass unit (MU) equals the initial spacecraft mass m₀, and the force unit (FU) = MU·DU/TU². Under this normalization the CRTBP equations depend only on the mass ratio μ, unifying the numerical scale and improving optimization convergence.
sources: Aziz et al. 2019, JGCD

fundamentals.definition_zh: 一种用于区分相空间中稳定区域和混沌区域的数值诊断工具。通过计算相邻初始条件的指数发散率，FLI值小的区域对应规则运动，值大的区域对应混沌运动。FLI截面图能直观呈现周期轨道、准周期轨道和混沌轨道的空间分布。
fundamentals.definition_en: A numerical diagnostic tool for distinguishing between regular and chaotic regions in phase space. It measures the exponential divergence rate of nearby initial conditions: low FLI values correspond to regular motion, while high values indicate chaos. FLI maps on surfaces of section reveal the spatial distribution of periodic, quasi-periodic, and chaotic orbits.
sources: Scott and Spencer, 2010, JGCD, DOI:10.2514/1.47791

fundamentals.definition_zh: 将地球和月球合并为单一第二主天体的圆型限制性三体问题简化模型。合并后质量比约为3.04×10⁻⁶，停泊轨道半径相应增大以匹配圆轨道速度。由于质量比很小，该近似在转移持续时间内提供了准确结果。
fundamentals.definition_en: An approximation in the circular restricted three-body problem that combines the Earth and Moon into a single second primary. The resulting mass ratio is approximately 3.04×10⁻⁶, and the parking orbit radius is adjusted accordingly. Due to the small mass ratio, this approximation provides accurate results for the duration of the transfer.
sources: Ocampo and Rosborough, 1993; Scott and Spencer, 2010, JGCD, DOI:10.2514/1.47791

fundamentals.definition_zh: 哈密顿动力学中的基本不变结构，由Kolmogorov-Arnold-Moser定理保证：在小的不可积扰动下，远离共振条件的不变环面仍然存在。KAM环面在相空间中充当障碍物，限制混沌轨道的扩展范围。
fundamentals.definition_en: Fundamental invariant structures in Hamiltonian dynamics, guaranteed by the Kolmogorov-Arnold-Moser theorem: under small non-integrable perturbations, invariant tori sufficiently far from resonance conditions persist. KAM tori act as barriers in phase space, confining the extent of chaotic orbits.
sources: Scott and Spencer, 2010, JGCD, DOI:10.2514/1.47791

fundamentals.definition_zh: 将连续动力系统降维为离散映射的超平面。在圆型限制性三体问题中常用y=0且ẏ<0的截面。轨道每次穿越该超平面上的一个点，通过反复积分形成庞加莱映射，可直观展示相空间中规则和混沌区域的分布。
fundamentals.definition_en: A hyperplane that reduces a continuous dynamical system to a discrete map. In the circular restricted three-body problem, the SOS is commonly defined by y=0 with ẏ<0. Each crossing of the hyperplane yields a point; repeated integration produces a Poincaré map that reveals the distribution of regular and chaotic regions in phase space.
sources: Scott and Spencer, 2010, JGCD, DOI:10.2514/1.47791

fundamentals.definition_zh: 通过逐步改变一个系统参数来追踪解曲线的数值方法。在轨道设计中，从一个已知解出发，通过预测步和校正步交替迭代，沿参数方向（如雅可比常数）连续追踪一族周期轨道或转移轨道，获得整个设计空间的解族。
fundamentals.definition_en: A numerical method that traces a curve of solutions by incrementally varying a system parameter. In trajectory design, starting from one known solution, prediction and correction steps alternate to continuously follow a family of periodic orbits or transfers along a parameter direction such as the Jacobi constant.
sources: Scott and Spencer, 2010, JGCD, DOI:10.2514/1.47791
Ren 等 - 2020

fundamentals.definition_zh: 衡量估计值与真实值偏差的统计量，通过计算误差平方均值再开方得到。在定轨分析中用于量化扩展卡尔曼滤波的估计精度。
fundamentals.definition_en: A statistical measure of estimator deviation from true values, computed as the square root of the mean squared error. Used in orbit determination analysis to quantify the estimation accuracy of an Extended Kalman Filter.
sources: Analysis of Autonomous Orbit Determination in Various Near-Moon Periodic Orbits (Qi & Oguri, 2023)

fundamentals.definition_zh: 相机姿态参数，类比二体问题的轨道根数定义（i, Omega, theta）。虽不再用于描述三体问题中的运动，但可用于描述航天器在给定时刻的姿态。
fundamentals.definition_en: Camera attitude parameters analogous to orbital elements in the two-body problem (i, Omega, theta). Though no longer describing motion in the three-body problem, they describe spacecraft attitude at a given timestep.
sources: Analysis of Autonomous Orbit Determination in Various Near-Moon Periodic Orbits (Qi & Oguri, 2023)

fundamentals.definition_zh: 将对称正定矩阵分解为下三角矩阵与其转置之积的方法。在地平线光学导航中用于将相机坐标系下的地平线观测矢量变换到因子分解空间并归一化，从而简化最小二乘求解过程。也用于生成相关高斯随机噪声。
fundamentals.definition_en: A method to decompose a symmetric positive definite matrix into the product of a lower triangular matrix and its transpose. In horizon-based optical navigation, it transforms horizon observation vectors from the camera frame into factorization space and normalizes them, simplifying the least-squares solution. Also used to generate correlated Gaussian random noise.
sources: Analysis of Autonomous Orbit Determination in Various Near-Moon Periodic Orbits (Qi & Oguri, 2023)

fundamentals.definition_zh: 包含多个天体真实历表数据（位置、速度）的高保真力学模型，计入太阳引力摄动、天体非球形引力等效应。相对于圆型限制性三体问题的理想化假设，完整历表模型更接近真实飞行环境。轨道设计通常先在三体模型中完成初步设计，再转入完整历表模型验证和精修。
fundamentals.definition_en: A high-fidelity dynamical model incorporating real ephemeris data (positions, velocities) of multiple celestial bodies, accounting for solar gravitational perturbations and non-spherical gravity effects. Compared to the idealized assumptions of the circular restricted three-body problem, it is closer to the real flight environment. Orbit design typically begins in the three-body model and transitions to the full-ephemeris model for verification and refinement.
sources: Grebow et al. 2008

fundamentals.definition_zh: 一种微分修正方法，将飞行时间作为自由变量与初始状态一同迭代，求解满足周期性等约束的精确轨道。与固定时间的瞄准方法相比，变时间瞄准的收敛域更大，适合从初始猜测快速生成周期轨道家族。本文用此方法系统计算L1和L2点附近的Halo轨道族和垂直轨道族。
fundamentals.definition_en: A differential correction method that treats flight time as a free variable, iterating it together with the initial state to solve for orbits satisfying constraints such as periodicity. Compared to fixed-time targeting, it has a larger convergence domain and is suitable for rapidly generating periodic orbit families from initial guesses. This paper uses the method to systematically compute halo and vertical orbit families near L1 and L2 points.
sources: Grebow et al. 2008

fundamentals.en: Minimum Time of Flight, Min TOF
fundamentals.definition_zh: 给定雅可比能量下，从最小停泊轨道出发到达月面的最短飞行时间。随雅可比能量增大呈阶梯式增长：C=2.08时约3天（类似直接转移），C=2.78时跳至约5天，C=2.98时突增至约46天，C=3.18时超过67天。阶梯式增长源于稳定流形与最小停泊轨道的非连续相交。
fundamentals.definition_en: The shortest flight time from the minimum parking orbit to the lunar surface for a given Jacobi energy. Shows stepped increase with energy: ~3 days at C=2.08 (direct-transfer-like), jumps to ~5 days at C=2.78, sharply rises to ~46 days at C=2.98, and exceeds 67 days at C=3.18. The stepped growth results from discontinuous intersections between stable manifolds and the minimum parking orbit.
sources: Liang et al. 2016

fundamentals.en: Two-Body Energy with Respect to the Moon
fundamentals.definition_zh: 航天器在近月点处相对于月球的二体轨道能量。E < 0是实现弹道捕获的必要条件（航天器能被月球引力自然捕获）；E > 0时只能月球飞越而无法绕月飞行。低能量转移的E为负值，直接转移的E为正值。
fundamentals.definition_en: The two-body orbital energy of a spacecraft relative to the Moon at its perilune. E < 0 is a necessary condition for ballistic capture; E > 0 permits only lunar flybys without orbital insertion. Low-energy transfers have negative E values while direct transfers have positive E values.
sources: Liang et al. 2016

fundamentals.definition_zh: 通过在参数空间中均匀离散化初始条件来搜索可行轨迹的方法。本文将雅可比能量C、初始y坐标和速度角θ分别以ΔC=0.01、Δθ=0.005°、Δy₀=0.01的步长离散化，生成120×360×100个网格点，逐一传播以获取全局轨迹分布。
fundamentals.definition_en: A method that searches for feasible trajectories by uniformly discretizing initial conditions across the parameter space. In this paper, Jacobi energy C, initial y-coordinate, and velocity angle θ are discretized with steps of ΔC=0.01, Δθ=0.005°, Δy₀=0.01, producing 120×360×100 grid points propagated to obtain global trajectory distributions.
sources: Liang et al. 2016

fundamentals.definition_zh: 在轨道上直接制造和组装大型结构的技术范式。与传统「装进火箭整流罩、扛住发射振动」的约束不同，ISAM 利用微失重环境制造百米乃至千米级精密结构，从根本上解除运载对传感器尺寸的限制。DARPA 的 NOM4D 计划是该方向的代表性项目。
fundamentals.definition_en: A technology paradigm for fabricating and assembling large structures directly on orbit. Unlike the traditional constraint of fitting components into a rocket fairing, ISAM leverages the microgravity environment to build structures at the 100–1,000 m scale, fundamentally removing launch-based size limitations for sensors and other space systems.
sources: DeCoster et al., 2026

fundamentals.definition_zh: 以平动点（或主星）为中心，坐标轴与椭圆运动主轴对齐的坐标系。它由旋转坐标系绕特定角度旋转得到，用于简化平动点附近的运动方程，使面内运动解耦为独立的两个方向。
fundamentals.definition_en: A coordinate frame centered at the libration point (or lead satellite) with axes aligned to the principal axes of the elliptical orbit. Obtained by rotating the synodic frame through a specific angle, it decouples the in-plane equations of motion into independent directions, simplifying the solution.
sources: Catlin and McLaughlin, 2007

fundamentals.definition_zh: 地球因自转导致赤道略微隆起、偏离完美球形的几何特征，通常用带谐系数（以J2为主）描述其非球形引力场。对三角平动点附近的相对运动，地球扁率引起的误差仅为毫米量级，可忽略不计。
fundamentals.definition_en: The geometric property of the Earth caused by its rotation, resulting in an equatorial bulge that deviates from a perfect sphere, typically described by zonal harmonics (dominated by J2). For relative motion near triangular libration points, the error from Earth oblateness is only on the order of millimeters and is negligible.
sources: Catlin and McLaughlin, 2007

fundamentals.definition_zh: 以航天器速度向量方向定义v轴、角动量向量方向定义n轴、构成右手系定义b轴的局部坐标系，用于描述推力矢量方向。
fundamentals.definition_en: A local coordinate frame where the v-axis is aligned with the spacecraft velocity vector, the n-axis is in the direction of the angular momentum vector, and the b-axis completes the right-handed orthonormal set, used to describe thrust vector direction.

fundamentals.definition_zh: 由状态转移矩阵构造的对称正定矩阵，定义为 C = Φ^T Φ，用于描述参考轨道附近线性动力学流在不同方向的拉伸与压缩特性。通过对 CGT 进行特征值分解或对状态转移矩阵进行奇异值分解，可以得到误差超椭球的拉伸幅度和方向，从而预测初始微小偏差在终端时刻的最大传播。
fundamentals.definition_en: A symmetric positive-definite matrix constructed from the state transition matrix as C = Φ^T Φ. It describes the stretching and compression characteristics of the linear dynamical flow near a reference trajectory in different directions. Through eigenvalue decomposition of CGT or singular value decomposition of the state transition matrix, the stretching magnitude and direction of the error hyper-ellipsoid can be obtained to predict maximum propagation of initial perturbations.
sources: Guzzetti et al. 2017
Muralidharan & Howell 2023

fundamentals.definition_zh: 描述航天器轨道状态不确定性的几何对象。初始时刻位置和速度误差的协方差矩阵定义了一个六维椭球，经状态转移矩阵线性映射后，终端时刻的误差分布仍为超椭球，但形状和大小发生改变。超椭球的主轴方向和半轴长度分别由 CGT 的特征向量和特征值决定。
fundamentals.definition_en: A geometric object describing the uncertainty of spacecraft orbital state. The covariance matrix of initial position and velocity errors defines a six-dimensional ellipsoid, which is linearly mapped by the state transition matrix to a terminal error hyper-ellipsoid with altered shape and size. The principal axes and semi-axis lengths are determined by the eigenvectors and eigenvalues of the CGT.
sources: Guzzetti et al. 2017
Muralidharan & Howell 2023

fundamentals.definition_zh: CGT 或状态转移矩阵奇异值分解中奇异值 σ_i 所代表的量，反映沿对应方向初始单位偏差被放大的倍数。最大拉伸幅度 σ_max = Σ_{11} 揭示初始误差可能造成的终端状态最大变化，是敏感性分析的核心指标。
fundamentals.definition_en: The singular values σ_i from the singular value decomposition of the CGT or state transition matrix, representing the amplification factor of a unit initial perturbation along the corresponding direction.
