navigation.definition_en: In an ISL-based autonomous orbit determination system, the speed at which orbit determination accuracy transitions from an inaccurate initial value to a steady state. In the paper, it is defined as the time required for the position RMSE to first fall below and consistently stay under the 100 m threshold. Increasing link quantity significantly accelerates convergence but with diminishing marginal returns.
sources: Li 等 - 2026 - A performance study on orbit determination using inter-satellite links between heterogeneous orbits

navigation.definition_zh: 星间链路伪距测量中零均值高斯测量噪声的标准差。论文分析了1m（高精度）、10m（nominal）、100m（低精度或极端条件）三个量级对定轨性能的影响，发现系统的可观测性决定了其对测距噪声的敏感程度。
navigation.definition_en: The standard deviation of zero-mean Gaussian measurement noise in ISL pseudorange measurements. The paper analyzes the impact of three noise levels (1 m for high precision, 10 m for nominal, and 100 m for low precision or extreme conditions) on orbit determination performance, finding that system observability determines its sensitivity to range measurement noise.
sources: Li 等 - 2026 - A performance study on orbit determination using inter-satellite links between heterogeneous orbits

navigation.definition_zh: 表征星间链路系统可观测性的信息矩阵，定义为各历元敏度矩阵加权求和。矩阵的奇异值分解用于计算系统条件数，其逆给出克拉美-罗下界。该矩阵从几何、测量权重和动力学传播三个方面综合反映链路组合的可观测性。
navigation.definition_en: An information matrix characterizing the observability of an ISL system, defined as the weighted sum of sensitivity matrices at each epoch. Singular value decomposition of this matrix yields the condition number, and its inverse gives the Cramer-Rao lower bound. The matrix comprehensively reflects the observability of a link configuration from three aspects: geometry, measurement weighting, and dynamical propagation.
sources: Li 等 - 2026 - A performance study on orbit determination using inter-satellite links between heterogeneous orbits

navigation.definition_zh: 评估导航星座定位精度的指标，反映伪距几何构型对三维空间定位误差的放大程度。PDOP 值越小，说明可见卫星的空间几何分布越有利于精确定位，星座性能越好。
navigation.definition_en: A metric evaluating the positioning accuracy of navigation constellations, reflecting how satellite-receiver geometric configuration amplifies three-dimensional positioning errors. Smaller PDOP values indicate more favorable spatial geometry and better constellation performance.
sources: He et al., 2025

navigation.definition_zh: 综合反映卫星几何构型对定位和授时误差放大效应的指标。GDOP 在 PDOP 基础上额外考虑用户钟差分量，值越小表明几何构型越优。
navigation.definition_en: A metric reflecting how satellite geometric configuration amplifies both positioning and timing errors. GDOP extends PDOP by incorporating the user clock bias component; smaller values indicate superior geometry.
sources: He et al., 2025
Teng 等 - 2025

navigation.definition_zh: 各卫星轨道周期成整数比关系的导航星座。这种共振特性使导航性能指标呈现周期性变化规律，有助于简化星座的日常管理和长期优化。
navigation.definition_en: A navigation constellation whose member satellites have orbital periods forming integer ratios. This resonant property causes navigation performance metrics to evolve periodically, simplifying constellation management and long-term optimization.
sources: He et al., 2025

navigation.definition_zh: 在地月旋转坐标系中沿 X、Y、Z 三轴均匀离散化的三维网格模型，适用于对整个地月系统等全局空间域的导航性能评估。
navigation.definition_en: A three-dimensional grid model with uniform discretization along X, Y, Z axes in the Earth-Moon rotating frame, suitable for navigation performance evaluation over global spatial domains such as the entire Earth-Moon system.
sources: He et al., 2025

navigation.definition_zh: 以经度、纬度和径向距离定义的局部空间网格模型，适用于评估地球或月球附近局部区域的导航性能。
navigation.definition_en: A local spatial grid model defined by longitude, latitude, and radial distance, suited for evaluating navigation performance in localized regions such as near-Earth or lunar proximity areas.
sources: He et al., 2025

navigation.definition_zh: 共振星座的 DOP 分布在随地月连线和白道面两个方向上均呈现对称的特征。这种对称性源于星座结构本身关于地月轴和月球轨道面的对称布局。
navigation.definition_en: The DOP distribution of a resonant constellation exhibits symmetric characteristics along both the Earth-Moon axis and the lunar orbital plane. This symmetry arises from the constellation's structural symmetry about these two reference directions.
sources: He et al., 2025

navigation.definition_zh: 记录星座中各颗卫星轨道类型编码和基准轨道周期的行向量，用于对共振星座进行分类、去重和检索，形式为 [o1, o2, ..., o_nsat, p0]。
navigation.definition_en: A row vector recording the orbit type codes and baseline period of each satellite in a constellation, used for categorizing, deduplicating, and retrieving resonant constellations. Its form is [o1, o2, ..., o_nsat, p0].
sources: He et al., 2025

navigation.definition_zh: 伪距随时间的变化率，由相位锁定环 PLL 提取的载波相位变化率计算得到。与伪距组合使用，为 GNSS 定轨提供距离和距离变化率双重观测量。
navigation.definition_en: The rate of change of pseudo-range, computed from carrier phase rate extracted by the phase-locked loop (PLL). Used alongside pseudo-range to provide both range and range-rate measurements for GNSS orbit determination.
sources: Analysis of Autonomous Orbit Determination in Various Near-Moon Periodic Orbits (Qi & Oguri, 2023)

navigation.definition_zh: 信号在自由空间中传播时因几何扩散而引起的功率衰减，与传播距离的平方成反比。是 GNSS 链路预算中计算接收功率的核心参数。
navigation.definition_en: The power衰减 of a signal propagating through free space due to geometric spreading, inversely proportional to the square of propagation distance. A core parameter in GNSS link budget calculations for received power.
sources: Analysis of Autonomous Orbit Determination in Various Near-Moon Periodic Orbits (Qi & Oguri, 2023)

navigation.definition_zh: 航天器与 GNSS 卫星之间的几何连线。视线计算需考虑地球和月球对信号的遮挡，以确定哪些 GNSS 卫星可提供有效观测量。
navigation.definition_en: The geometric line connecting a spacecraft and a GNSS satellite. LoS calculations account for signal blockages by Earth and Moon to determine which GNSS satellites provide valid measurements.
sources: Analysis of Autonomous Orbit Determination in Various Near-Moon Periodic Orbits (Qi & Oguri, 2023)

navigation.definition_zh: 体积小、功耗低的微型原子钟，功率谱密度系数 h0 和 h-1 表征其频率稳定度。论文选用 Jackson Lab CSAC 作为星载时钟模型，代表 CubeSat 级任务的低成本方案。
navigation.definition_en: A miniature atomic clock with small size and low power consumption, characterized by power spectral density coefficients h0 and h-1 for frequency stability. The Jackson Lab CSAC is used as the onboard clock model, representing a low-cost solution for CubeSat-class missions.
sources: Analysis of Autonomous Orbit Determination in Various Near-Moon Periodic Orbits (Qi & Oguri, 2023)

navigation.definition_zh: 衡量振荡器（如原子钟）频率稳定度的统计量。与阿伦偏差（Allan Deviation）的区别在于：方差是偏差的平方。在 GNSS 定轨中用于描述星载时钟钟差和钟漂随机过程的功率谱密度系数。
navigation.definition_en: A statistical measure of frequency stability in oscillators such as atomic clocks. It is the square of the Allan deviation. Used in GNSS orbit determination to characterize the power spectrum density coefficients of onboard clock bias and drift random processes.
sources: Analysis of Autonomous Orbit Determination in Various Near-Moon Periodic Orbits (Qi & Oguri, 2023)

navigation.definition_zh: GNSS 接收机中用于跟踪伪码相位的反馈环路。通过比较早、迟本地伪码与接收信号的相关输出，锁定伪码到达时间，从而提取伪距观测量。环路带宽和码片时间共同决定其测距精度。
navigation.definition_en: A feedback loop in GNSS receivers used to track the phase of the pseudo-random code. By comparing early and late local code correlations with the received signal, it locks onto code arrival time to extract pseudo-range measurements. Tracking accuracy depends on loop bandwidth and chipping time.
sources: Analysis of Autonomous Orbit Determination in Various Near-Moon Periodic Orbits (Qi & Oguri, 2023)

navigation.definition_zh: GNSS 接收机中用于跟踪载波相位的反馈环路。通过锁定接收信号的载波相位，提取伪距变化率（多普勒）观测量。其相位噪声方差取决于相干积分时间和环路带宽。
navigation.definition_en: A feedback loop in GNSS receivers used to track carrier phase. By locking onto the carrier phase of the received signal, it extracts pseudo-range rate (Doppler) measurements. Phase noise variance depends on coherent integration time and loop bandwidth.
sources: Analysis of Autonomous Orbit Determination in Various Near-Moon Periodic Orbits (Qi & Oguri, 2023)

navigation.definition_zh: GNSS 接收机能够有效跟踪和解调信号的最低载噪比值。低于此门限的信号被判定为无效，不参与定轨解算。典型商用接收机门限约为 15 dB-Hz。
navigation.definition_en: The minimum carrier-to-noise ratio at which a GNSS receiver can effectively track and demodulate a signal. Signals below this threshold are deemed invalid and excluded from orbit determination. Typical commercial receivers have a threshold around 15 dB-Hz.
sources: Analysis of Autonomous Orbit Determination in Various Near-Moon Periodic Orbits (Qi & Oguri, 2023)

navigation.definition_zh: GNSS 伪随机码单个码片的持续时间，等于码片速率的倒数。L1 频段 C/A 码的码片时间约为 9.78e-7 秒。码片时间直接影响延迟锁定环的伪距测量精度。
navigation.definition_en: The duration of a single chip of a GNSS pseudo-random code, equal to the reciprocal of the chipping rate. For the L1 C/A code, the chipping time is approximately 9.78e-7 seconds. It directly affects the pseudo-range measurement accuracy of the delay-locked loop.
sources: Analysis of Autonomous Orbit Determination in Various Near-Moon Periodic Orbits (Qi & Oguri, 2023)

navigation.definition_zh: 天线辐射特性随空间方向变化的图形表示。通常以锥角和方位角为自变量，描述天线增益或方向性的方向分布。GPS 卫星的天线方向图决定其信号覆盖范围，是地月空间 GNSS 导航分析的关键输入。
navigation.definition_en: A graphical representation of an antenna's radiation characteristics as a function of spatial direction. Typically parameterized by cone angle and azimuth, it describes the directional distribution of gain or directivity. GPS satellite antenna patterns determine signal coverage and are key inputs for cislunar GNSS navigation analysis.
sources: Analysis of Autonomous Orbit Determination in Various Near-Moon Periodic Orbits (Qi & Oguri, 2023)

navigation.definition_zh: 将天线方向性系数转换为发射天线增益的修正量。增益等于方向性加上增益校正因子（dB），用于扣除天线内部损耗。GPS 卫星 L1 频段的增益校正因子约为 -1.4 dB。
navigation.definition_en: A correction applied to convert antenna directivity to transmitter antenna gain. Gain equals directivity plus the gain correction factor (in dB), accounting for internal antenna losses. For GPS satellite L1 band, GCF is approximately -1.4 dB.
sources: Analysis of Autonomous Orbit Determination in Various Near-Moon Periodic Orbits (Qi & Oguri, 2023)

navigation.zh: 有效各向同性辐射功率
navigation.definition_zh: 发射天线增益与发射功率之和（dB），表示天线在最大辐射方向上等效于全向天线的辐射功率。EIRP 是 GNSS 链路预算的核心参数，决定信号在接收端的功率水平。
navigation.definition_en: The sum of transmitter antenna gain and transmitter power (in dB), representing the equivalent power an isotropic antenna would need to radiate in the direction of maximum radiation. EIRP is a core parameter in GNSS link budgets, determining the signal power level at the receiver.
sources: Analysis of Autonomous Orbit Determination in Various Near-Moon Periodic Orbits (Qi & Oguri, 2023)

navigation.definition_zh: 利用光学相机拍摄天体图像，通过测量天体的视直径、边缘轮廓或像素位置来确定航天器相对位置的自主导航方法。在月球任务中，通过检测月球地平线实现相对于月心的定位，设备简单且成本低。
navigation.definition_en: An autonomous navigation method that uses optical cameras to capture celestial body images and determines spacecraft relative position by measuring apparent diameter, limb contour, or pixel location. In lunar missions, it achieves positioning relative to the Moon center by detecting the lunar horizon, requiring simple and low-cost equipment.
sources: Analysis of Autonomous Orbit Determination in Various Near-Moon Periodic Orbits (Qi & Oguri, 2023)

navigation.definition_zh: 一种光学导航方法，通过在图像中识别天体地平线并提取地平线矢量，利用 Cholesky 因子分解和最小二乘法求解天体中心方向，进而确定航天器相对于天体的三维位置。Christian-Robinson 算法是该方法的代表性非迭代实现。
navigation.definition_en: A type of optical navigation that identifies celestial body horizons in images, extracts horizon vectors, and uses Cholesky factorization with least squares to solve for the body center direction, yielding the spacecraft's 3D position relative to the body. The Christian-Robinson algorithm is a representative non-iterative implementation.
sources: Analysis of Autonomous Orbit Determination in Various Near-Moon Periodic Orbits (Qi & Oguri, 2023)

navigation.definition_zh: 天体在观测者视角下所张的角度直径。航天器距月球越近，月球视直径越大，相机图像中月球边缘占据的像素越多，光学导航精度越高。视直径的变化范围是评估轨道对光学导航适用性的关键指标。
navigation.definition_en: The angular diameter of a celestial body as seen from the observer's viewpoint. The closer the spacecraft is to the Moon, the larger the apparent diameter, the more pixels the lunar limb occupies in the camera image, and the higher the optical navigation accuracy. The range of apparent diameter variation is a key metric for evaluating orbital suitability for optical navigation.
sources: Analysis of Autonomous Orbit Determination in Various Near-Moon Periodic Orbits (Qi & Oguri, 2023)

navigation.definition_zh: 描述航天器星载时钟与 GPS 系统时之间偏差的数学模型。通常将钟差和钟漂建模为带有阿伦方差驱动噪声的随机游走过程，其功率谱密度系数取决于时钟类型（如芯片级原子钟 CSAC）。
navigation.definition_en: A mathematical model describing the bias between a spacecraft's onboard clock and GPS system time. Clock bias and drift are typically modeled as a random walk process driven by Allan variance noise, with power spectral density coefficients depending on the clock type (e.g., CSAC).
sources: Analysis of Autonomous Orbit Determination in Various Near-Moon Periodic Orbits (Qi & Oguri, 2023)

navigation.zh: 远距逆行轨道阴影遮挡
navigation.definition_zh: 远距逆行轨道运行过程中，月球遮挡地球方向 GNSS 信号源的现象。轨道周期越短的 DRO，被遮挡时间占轨道周期的比例越大，导致 GNSS 信号中断时段增加，定轨误差方差显著增大。是制约纯 GNSS 在该类轨道上定轨性能的关键因素。
navigation.definition_en: The phenomenon where the Moon blocks Earth-direction GNSS signal sources during distant retrograde orbits. Shorter-period DROs experience GNSS shadowing for a larger fraction of their orbital period, increasing signal outage and significantly enlarging orbit determination error variance. This is a key factor limiting GNSS-only orbit determination performance on such orbits.
sources: Analysis of Autonomous Orbit Determination in Various Near-Moon Periodic Orbits (Qi & Oguri, 2023)

navigation.definition_zh: 航天器在 Halo 轨道附近实现相对位置和速度匹配的控制过程。与近地轨道交会不同，Halo 轨道交会面临三个特殊挑战：轨道动力学的强非线性、周期轨道本身的不稳定性（沿不稳定流形方向的微小扰动会导致快速偏离）、以及周期长（数天量级）带来的大范围相对运动。通常分远距离导引和近距离最终逼近两个阶段。
navigation.definition_en: A control process for spacecraft to achieve relative position and velocity matching near a Halo orbit. Unlike low-Earth-orbit rendezvous, it faces strong nonlinear dynamics, inherent orbital instability along unstable manifolds, and large-scale relative motion due to multi-day orbital periods.

navigation.definition_zh: 一种小推力制导方法，以轨道根数（半长轴、偏心率）的误差构建Lyapunov函数，沿最大梯度方向求解控制律，使轨道逐步趋近目标值。本文用此方法设计GEO离轨和月球捕获的小推力段。
navigation.definition_en: A low-thrust guidance method that constructs a Lyapunov function from orbital element errors (semi-major axis, eccentricity) and solves the control law along the maximum gradient direction to progressively steer the orbit toward target values. Used in this paper for the low-thrust segments of GEO deorbiting and lunar capture.
sources: Liang et al. 2016

navigation.definition_zh: 一种 DRO 编队轨道保持算法的思路：基于目标点法思想，在近月点处施加修正脉冲，利用状态转移矩阵预测下一目标点处的相对位置偏差，通过求解线性方程组计算速度增量，使副星在下一目标点处严格回归参考轨迹。该方法不依赖主星实时状态信息，使用方便，在参考轨迹跟踪精度方面略有优势。
navigation.definition_en: A stationkeeping algorithm concept for DRO formation flight: based on the target-point approach, correction impulses are applied at perilune. Using the state transition matrix to predict relative position deviation at the next target point, velocity increments are computed by solving linear equations to make the deputy strictly return to the reference trajectory at the target point. This method does not require real-time chief state information and has a slight advantage in reference trajectory tracking accuracy.
sources: 敖海跃等 2024

navigation.definition_zh: 为深空探测和地月空间任务提供测距、测速、测角等跟踪测量服务的地面站网络。中国深空测控网（CDSN）用于对地月空间航天器进行测定轨，但由于 DRO 航天器距地球数十万公里、运动缓慢，导航结果通常需要 2 至 3 天才能收敛。
navigation.definition_en: A ground station network providing tracking measurement services including range, range rate, and angular measurement for deep space exploration and cislunar missions. The Chinese Deep Space Network (CDSN) performs orbit determination for cislunar spacecraft, but due to DRO spacecraft's large distance from Earth and slow motion, navigation results typically require 2 to 3 days to converge.
sources: 敖海跃等 2024

navigation.definition_zh: 航天器轨道确定中的位置和速度测量误差，包括注入误差和观测误差。
navigation.definition_en: Position and velocity measurement errors in spacecraft orbit determination, including injection errors and observation errors.
sources: Gao 等 - 2023 - Low-thrust station-keeping control for lunar near rectilinear halo orbits

navigation.definition_zh: 轨道确定中测量更新的时间频率，本文中设为1小时。
navigation.definition_en: The time frequency of measurement updates in orbit determination, set to 1 hour in this paper.
sources: Gao 等 - 2023 - Low-thrust station-keeping control for lunar near rectilinear halo orbits

navigation.definition_zh: 以地月平动点轨道（LPO）为基础卫星轨道，通过优化配置多颗卫星实现地月空间通信与导航服务的星座系统。相比传统卫星轨道，平动点轨道提供更多样化的轨道选项和更灵活的空间布局。
navigation.definition_en: A satellite constellation based on libration point orbits (LPOs), achieving communication and navigation services across cislunar space through optimized multi-satellite configurations. Compared with traditional Keplerian satellite orbits, LPOs offer more diverse orbital options and more flexible spatial arrangements.
sources: Xu et al., 2026, Tsinghua University Press

navigation.definition_zh: 一种分阶段平动点轨道星座优化方法：第一步以轨道家族为参数快速筛选候选族；第二步以轨道幅值为参数从候选族中选择最优构型。该方法通过先验信息缩小优化范围，再结合遗传算法（GA）和禁忌搜索（TS）进行全局探索与局部细化，显著提高优化效率。
navigation.definition_en: A staged LPO constellation optimization method: the first step rapidly screens candidate families using orbit family as the parameter; the second step selects the optimal configuration from candidate families using orbit amplitude as the parameter. By using prior information to narrow the optimization scope and combining genetic algorithms (GA) with Tabu search (TS) for global exploration and local refinement, this method significantly improves optimization efficiency.
sources: Xu et al., 2026, Tsinghua University Press

navigation.definition_zh: 将目标服务区域离散化为网格点集以评估星座性能的方法。采用地月质心会合坐标系，以地月距离为参考半径绘制圆形网格，并在月球路径上加密形成带状区域。该方法将连续的空间区域转化为有限数量的计算点，从而可定量评估星座的覆盖、通信与导航性能。
navigation.definition_en: A method to discretize the target service region into a grid point set for constellation performance evaluation. Using the Earth-Moon barycentric synodic coordinate system, a circular grid is drawn with the Earth-Moon distance as the reference radius, and a banded region is formed along the Moon's path through densification. This method converts continuous spatial regions into a finite number of computational points, enabling quantitative evaluation of constellation coverage, communication, and navigation performance.
sources: Xu et al., 2026, Tsinghua University Press

navigation.definition_zh: 分三个阶段建设平动点轨道通信导航星座的策略：第一阶段单颗NRHO卫星实现地月转移关键区域单重覆盖；第二阶段增至7颗卫星分布于L1、L2、L4、L5及NRHO轨道，实现双重区域四重覆盖；第三阶段再增2颗L3平动点卫星达9颗，实现全地月空间四重覆盖。
navigation.definition_en: A strategy for constructing an LPO communication and navigation constellation in three phases: Phase 1 uses a single NRHO satellite to achieve single coverage of the Earth-Moon transfer critical region; Phase 2 expands to 7 satellites distributed on L1, L2, L4, L5 and NRHO orbits to achieve quadruple coverage of both regions; Phase 3 adds 2 L3 libration point satellites to reach 9 satellites, achieving quadruple coverage across the entire cislunar space.
sources: Xu et al., 2026, Tsinghua University Press

navigation.definition_zh: 仅依靠星间链路（ISL）观测数据进行轨道确定的自主导航方法。基于双程测距（DOWR）模式，卫星状态与钟差计算可通过联合观测解耦，实现不依赖地面站的完全自主轨道确定。
navigation.definition_en: An autonomous navigation method that performs orbit determination solely based on inter-satellite link (ISL) observation data. Under the dual-one-way ranging (DOWR) mode, satellite state and clock error calculations can be decoupled through combined observations, enabling fully autonomous orbit determination without relying on ground stations.
sources: Xu et al., 2026, Tsinghua University Press

navigation.definition_zh: 根据服务优先级赋予不同权值的网格点。在多目标优化中，通过提高关键区域的权值（如将地月转移关键区域权值设为10而其他区域默认为1），确保优化结果优先满足高优先级区域的服务质量需求。
navigation.definition_en: Grid points assigned different weights according to service priority. In multi-objective optimization, by increasing weights for critical regions (e.g., setting the Earth-Moon transfer critical region weight to 10 while other regions default to 1), the optimization results are ensured to prioritize the service quality needs of high-priority regions.
sources: Xu et al., 2026, Tsinghua University Press

navigation.definition_zh: 轨道确定过程中引入的位置和速度测量偏差，用零均值高斯分布建模。
navigation.definition_en: Position and velocity measurement deviations in the orbit determination process, modeled with zero-mean Gaussian distributions.
sources: /home/ouyangjiahong/Downloads/地月空间相关/output/Fu 等 - 2022 - Stochastic optimization for stationkeeping of periodic orbits using a high-order target point approa/hybrid_auto/Fu 等 - 2022 - Stochastic optimization for stationkeeping of periodic orbits using a high-order target point approa.md

navigation.definition_zh: 追踪飞行器进入目标空间站10公里范围后，采用GPM-PPC执行六自由度相对运动控制、完成高精度对接的最终阶段。
navigation.definition_en: The final phase where the chaser spacecraft executes 6-DOF relative motion control using GPM-PPC to perform high-precision docking maneuvers within a 10 km proximity to the target space station.
sources: Liu 等 - 2025 - Rendezvous and docking operations in near rectilinear halo orbits

navigation.definition_zh: 航天器在地月空间内不依赖地球通信实现自主状态更新的导航方式。
navigation.definition_en: Spacecraft navigation in cislunar space without requiring contact with Earth for state updates.
sources: Christian和Lightsey - 2009 - Review of options for autonomous cislunar navigation

navigation.definition_zh: 通过积分加速度计和陀螺仪测量值，结合重力模型，在无外部环境测量情况下追踪航天器位置和速度的方法。
navigation.definition_en: Method of tracking spacecraft position and velocity by integrating accelerometer and gyro measurements combined with a gravity model, without requiring external environment measurements.
sources: Christian和Lightsey - 2009 - Review of options for autonomous cislunar navigation

navigation.definition_zh: 通过测量天体视直径来估算航天器到天体距离的方法，距离越近视直径越大。
navigation.definition_en: Method of estimating range to a celestial body by measuring its apparent angular diameter; closer distance yields larger apparent diameter.
sources: Christian和Lightsey - 2009 - Review of options for autonomous cislunar navigation

navigation.definition_zh: 恒星被地球或月球遮挡消失的现象，通过测量掩星时间可确定航天器位置。
navigation.definition_en: Phenomenon where a star is eclipsed by Earth or Moon; measuring occultation timing can determine spacecraft position.
sources: Christian和Lightsey - 2009 - Review of options for autonomous cislunar navigation

navigation.definition_zh: 利用脉冲星稳定的X射线脉冲信号进行航天器定位和定速的导航方法。
navigation.definition_en: Navigation method using stable X-ray pulse signals from pulsars for spacecraft position and velocity determination.
sources: Christian和Lightsey - 2009 - Review of options for autonomous cislunar navigation

navigation.definition_zh: 速度矢量与当地水平面之间的夹角，是载人飞船返回的关键导航参数。
navigation.definition_en: Angle between velocity vector and local horizontal; critical navigation parameter for crewed spacecraft return.
sources: Christian和Lightsey - 2009 - Review of options for autonomous cislunar navigation

navigation.definition_zh: 阿波罗飞船上用于测量地球或月球表面特征与参考恒星之间角度的手动操作光学仪器。
navigation.definition_en: Manual optical instrument on Apollo spacecraft used to measure angles between Earth/Moon surface features and reference stars.
sources: Christian和Lightsey - 2009 - Review of options for autonomous cislunar navigation

navigation.definition_zh: 太阳系质量中心，作为脉冲星观测和深空导航的惯性参考点。
navigation.definition_en: Center of mass of the solar system, used as inertial reference point for pulsar observations and deep space navigation.
sources: Christian和Lightsey - 2009 - Review of options for autonomous cislunar navigation

navigation.definition_zh: 通过匹配光学图像与已知地形特征实现自主定位的导航方法。
navigation.definition_en: Autonomous navigation method by matching optical images with known terrain features.
sources: Christian和Lightsey - 2009 - Review of options for autonomous cislunar navigation

navigation.definition_zh: 通过地面站测量信号实现航天器跟踪的传统方法，如深空网络和跟踪与数据中继卫星系统。
navigation.definition_en: Traditional spacecraft tracking via ground-based signal measurement, e.g., Deep Space Network and TDRSS.
sources: Christian和Lightsey - 2009 - Review of options for autonomous cislunar navigation

navigation.definition_zh: 通过光学手段观测GPS或地球静止卫星进行导航的方法。
navigation.definition_en: Navigation method by optically observing GPS or geostationary satellites.
sources: Christian和Lightsey - 2009 - Review of options for autonomous cislunar navigation

navigation.zh: 跟踪与数据中继卫星系统
navigation.en: Tracking and Data Relay Satellite System
navigation.definition_zh: NASA的空间跟踪和数据中继系统，支持近地轨道航天器的跟踪和通信。
navigation.definition_en: NASA's space tracking and data relay system supporting LEO spacecraft tracking and communication.
sources: Christian和Lightsey - 2009 - Review of options for autonomous cislunar navigation

navigation.definition_zh: 通过图像处理确定天体或目标亮度中心位置的技术。
navigation.definition_en: Technique of determining the brightness center of a celestial body or target through image processing.
sources: Christian和Lightsey - 2009 - Review of options for autonomous cislunar navigation

navigation.definition_zh: 检测地球或月球地平线位置以确定航天器姿态的仪器。
navigation.definition_en: Instrument detecting Earth or Moon horizon position to determine spacecraft attitude.
sources: Christian和Lightsey - 2009 - Review of options for autonomous cislunar navigation

navigation.definition_zh: 脉冲星X射线脉冲到达航天器的时间，是脉冲星导航的核心测量量。
navigation.definition_en: Time when pulsar X-ray pulse arrives at spacecraft; core measurement for pulsar navigation.
sources: Christian和Lightsey - 2009 - Review of options for autonomous cislunar navigation

navigation.en: State Dependent Riccati Equation Guidance, SDRE Guidance
navigation.definition_zh: 一种非线性最优制导方法，将相对运动动力学参数化为状态依赖系数形式，求解状态依赖的Riccati方程得到时变反馈增益。适用于近程交会末段，可处理安全走廊等末端约束。
navigation.definition_en: A nonlinear optimal guidance method that parameterizes relative motion dynamics into state-dependent coefficient form and solves time-varying feedback gains via the state-dependent Riccati equation. Suitable for the terminal phase of proximity rendezvous, handling end constraints such as safety corridors.
sources: Innocenti et al., 2022

navigation.definition_zh: 目标航天器周围半径约1公里的球形区域，用于划分主动安全与被动安全阶段。位于会合球外时采用开环脉冲制导，进入会合球后切换为闭环制导。
navigation.definition_en: A spherical region of approximately 1 km radius surrounding the target spacecraft, used to demarcate active and passive safety phases. Open-loop impulsive guidance is used outside the rendezvous sphere; closed-loop guidance activates after entering it.
sources: Innocenti et al., 2022

navigation.definition_zh: 当执行机构失效导致无法按原计划完成交会时，在目标轨道的不稳定流形上重新选择保持点位置，通过图优化方法确定新的机动序列，使追踪航天器在下一个运行周期内安全抵达目标。
navigation.definition_en: When actuator failure prevents completing rendezvous as planned, selecting new hold point locations on the unstable manifold of the target orbit and determining a new maneuver sequence via graph optimization, allowing the chaser to safely reach the target in the next orbital period.
sources: Innocenti et al., 2022

navigation.zh: 邻接矩阵法保持点优化
navigation.definition_zh: 用62×62邻接矩阵表示所有保持点候选位置之间的转移代价，通过Dijkstra算法在图中搜索最优保持点序列。代价函数包含漂移代价、随机方向碰撞角代价和ΔV代价三个部分。
navigation.definition_en: Representing transfer costs between all hold point candidate locations using a 62×62 adjacency matrix and searching for the optimal hold point sequence via Dijkstra's algorithm. The cost function consists of drift cost, random-direction collision angle cost, and ΔV cost components.
sources: Innocenti et al., 2022

navigation.definition_zh: 基于特殊长周期轨道部署34颗导航卫星，通过星间链路实现自主轨道确定和时间同步，为地月空间用户提供PNT服务的卫星导航系统。
navigation.definition_en: A satellite navigation system deploying 34 navigation satellites on Special Long-Period Orbits, achieving autonomous orbit determination and time synchronization through inter-satellite links to provide PNT services for cislunar space users.
sources: Teng 等 - 2025

navigation.definition_zh: 卫星A和B在同一时刻互相发射和接收测距信号，通过双向伪距测量值的加减消除几何距离或钟差分量，实现星间距离和钟差的解耦估计。
navigation.definition_en: Satellites A and B transmit and receive ranging signals at the same epoch; by adding and subtracting the dual one-way pseudorange measurements, the geometric distance or clock offset components are eliminated, enabling decoupled estimation of inter-satellite range and clock offset.
sources: Teng 等 - 2025

navigation.definition_zh: 对星座内所有星载原子钟的读数进行等权加权组合建立的初始虚拟时钟基准，用于实现星座内部的时间传递和同步。
navigation.definition_en: An initial virtual clock reference established by equally weighting all spaceborne atomic clock readings within the constellation, used for time transfer and synchronization within the constellation.
sources: Teng 等 - 2025

navigation.zh: 星际卫星轨道自主导航
navigation.en: Linked, Autonomous, Interplanetary Satellite Orbit Navigation, LiAISON
navigation.definition_zh: 利用平动点附近引力不对称性，通过星间测量数据实现航天器绝对轨道自主确定的导航方法。
navigation.definition_en: A navigation method that achieves autonomous absolute orbit determination of spacecraft using inter-satellite measurement data by leveraging gravitational asymmetry near libration points.
sources: Teng 等 - 2025

navigation.definition_zh: 导航卫星向用户航天器播发的导航信号，包含卫星星历、钟差参数等，用户通过接收该信号实现自主定位定轨。
navigation.definition_en: Navigation signals broadcast by navigation satellites to user spacecraft, containing satellite ephemeris and clock offset parameters, enabling users to achieve autonomous positioning and orbit determination by receiving these signals.
sources: Teng 等 - 2025

navigation.definition_zh: 北斗卫星导航系统的高精度时间基准，用于对CSNS星座内部时间进行外部溯源和校准。
navigation.definition_en: The high-precision time reference of the Beidou satellite navigation system, used for external traceability and calibration of the CSNS constellation internal time.
sources: Teng 等 - 2025

navigation.definition_zh: 描述星载原子钟误差传播的二次多项式模型，包含钟差、钟漂和钟老化三个参数，用于自主时间同步中的钟差估计与预测。
navigation.definition_en: A quadratic polynomial model describing the propagation of spaceborne atomic clock errors, containing three parameters: clock offset, clock drift, and clock aging, used for clock offset estimation and prediction in autonomous time synchronization.
sources: Teng 等 - 2025

navigation.definition_zh: 基于双向时间频率传递原理，利用星间DOWR数据计算卫星间相对钟差，进而确定每颗导航卫星相对参考时间标准的钟差，实现星座内部时间基准的维持。
navigation.definition_en: Based on the principle of bidirectional time-frequency transfer, using inter-satellite DOWR data to calculate the relative clock offset between satellites, thereby determining each navigation satellite's clock offset relative to the reference time standard, achieving maintenance of the internal time reference of the constellation.
sources: Teng 等 - 2025

navigation.en: Positioning, Navigation and Timing Service in Cislunar Space, PNT
navigation.definition_zh: 为地月空间内的地球轨道卫星、地月转移轨道卫星和月球轨道卫星提供的定位、导航和授时服务。
navigation.definition_en: Positioning, navigation and timing services provided for satellites in Earth orbits, lunar transfer orbits, and lunar orbits within cislunar space.
sources: Teng 等 - 2025

navigation.definition_zh: 通过双程单向测距的两个伪距观测量的加减运算，将距离信息和钟差信息分离的处理方法。
navigation.definition_en: A processing method that separates range information from clock offset information through addition and subtraction operations of the two pseudorange observations from dual one-way ranging.
sources: Teng 等 - 2025

navigation.definition_zh: 由钟差、钟漂和钟老化组成的星载原子钟状态向量，用于描述原子钟的误差传播特性。
navigation.definition_en: The spaceborne atomic clock state vector composed of clock offset, clock drift, and clock aging, used to describe the error propagation characteristics of atomic clocks.
sources: Teng 等 - 2025

navigation.definition_zh: 利用星座内所有卫星间的星间测距数据，联合估计整个星座所有卫星轨道状态和钟状态的处理方法。
navigation.definition_en: A processing method that jointly estimates the orbital states and clock states of all satellites in the entire constellation using inter-satellite ranging data among all satellites within the constellation.
sources: Teng 等 - 2025

navigation.definition_zh: 利用地月系统L1和L2平动点附近的引力不对称性，通过星间链路实现绝对定位的导航体制。
navigation.definition_en: A navigation method that achieves absolute positioning through inter-satellite links by utilizing gravitational asymmetry near the L1 and L2 libration points of the Earth-Moon system.
sources: Teng 等 - 2025

navigation.definition_zh: 在地月空间及更远的深空环境中确定航天器位置和速度的技术。论文提出的特征参数方法可应用于深空导航中的轨道确定。
navigation.definition_en: Techniques for determining spacecraft position and velocity in cislunar and deeper space environments. The characteristic parameter method proposed can be applied to orbit determination in deep space navigation.
sources: Orbital parameter characterization and objects cataloging for Earth-moon collinear libration points
Vepa - 2024 - Space vehicle maneuvering, propulsion, dynamics and control

navigation.definition_zh: 定义保持点位置的几何策略，追踪器始终沿目标对接方向进入传感器的视野锥内。
navigation.definition_en: A geometric strategy to define hold point positions, where the chaser always approaches the target along the docking port direction within the field of view of rendezvous sensors modeled by a cone.
sources: Lizy-Destrez et al. 2019

navigation.definition_zh: 另一种定义保持点位置的几何策略，追踪器保持在视野锥的同一侧而非穿越视线。
navigation.definition_en: A geometric strategy where the chaser does not cross the line-of-sight but remains on the same side of the cone during approach.
sources: Lizy-Destrez et al. 2019

navigation.definition_zh: 以目标为中心的最小安全区域，半径通常200米，追踪器绝对不得进入。
navigation.definition_en: The innermost safety sphere centered on the target with radius typically 200 m, which the chaser must never enter to avoid collision.
sources: Lizy-Destrez et al. 2019

navigation.definition_zh: 交会对接的第一个阶段，追踪航天器与目标距离从10000公里接近到100公里，采用绝对位置控制与开环脉冲机动。
navigation.definition_en: The first phase of rendezvous where the chaser approaches the target from 10000 km to 100 km, using absolute position control and open-loop impulsive maneuvers.
sources: Colagrossi 等 - 2021

navigation.definition_zh: 交会对接的第二个阶段，追踪航天器与目标距离从100公里接近到1公里，采用相对位置控制，可使用脉冲或连续推力。
navigation.definition_en: The second phase of rendezvous where the chaser approaches the target from 100 km to 1 km, using relative position control with impulsive or continuous thrust.
sources: Colagrossi 等 - 2021

navigation.definition_zh: 交会对接的最后阶段，在1公里安全球以内，采用六自由度耦合闭环制导与视觉导航。
navigation.definition_en: The final phase of rendezvous within the 1 km keep-out sphere, using 6DOF coupled closed-loop guidance and vision-based navigation.
sources: Colagrossi 等 - 2021

navigation.definition_zh: 交会对接过程中设定的等待点，追踪航天器在此处暂停或进行轨道调整，确保与目标的时间配合。
navigation.definition_en: A waiting point set during rendezvous where the chaser pauses or performs orbital adjustments to ensure timing coordination with the target.
sources: Colagrossi 等 - 2021

navigation.definition_zh: 以目标航天器为中心的安全区域，半径1公里，用于碰撞风险评估与碰撞规避机动触发。
navigation.definition_en: A safety zone centered on the target spacecraft with a radius of 1 km, used for collision risk assessment and triggering collision avoidance maneuvers.
sources: Colagrossi 等 - 2021

navigation.definition_zh: 距离目标200米的球形区域，进入后转为直线逼近模式，最大相对速度限制在10厘米每秒。
navigation.definition_en: A spherical region at 200 m from the target; after entering, a straight-line approach mode is activated with maximum relative velocity limited to 10 cm/s.
sources: Colagrossi 等 - 2021

navigation.definition_zh: 仅使用光学相机获取目标图像，通过特征点提取与滤波估计实现追踪航天器相对目标的位置和姿态估计。
navigation.definition_en: Using only optical cameras to capture target images, estimating the chaser's relative position and attitude through feature point extraction and filtering.
sources: Colagrossi 等 - 2021

navigation.definition_zh: 由两个相隔一定基线距离的相机组成的视觉传感器系统，可通过视差原理恢复特征点的三维位置。
navigation.definition_en: A vision sensor system composed of two cameras separated by a certain baseline distance, capable of recovering 3D positions of feature points through parallax.
sources: Colagrossi 等 - 2021

navigation.definition_zh: 忽略镜头畸变的理想相机模型，假设所有光线通过无限小孔投射到像面上，建立三维空间点与二维像点的几何关系。
navigation.definition_en: An ideal camera model ignoring lens distortion, assuming all light rays pass through an infinitely small hole to project onto the image plane, establishing geometric relationships between 3D points and 2D image points.
sources: Colagrossi 等 - 2021

navigation.definition_zh: 目标航天器上已知的标记点（如LED或光学标志点），用于视觉导航中的位姿估计。
navigation.definition_en: Known markers (such as LEDs or visual markers) on the target spacecraft used for pose estimation in visual navigation.
sources: Colagrossi 等 - 2021

navigation.definition_zh: 以推进剂消耗最小为目标的交会对接制导方法，将控制量归一化后对控制能量泛函进行优化。
navigation.definition_en: A rendezvous guidance method aimed at minimizing propellant consumption, achieved by normalizing control inputs and optimizing a control energy functional.
sources: Colagrossi 等 - 2021

navigation.definition_zh: 当检测到碰撞风险时执行的紧急机动，通常在相对距离和速度满足特定条件时触发。
navigation.definition_en: An emergency maneuver executed when a collision risk is detected, usually triggered when relative distance and velocity meet specific conditions.
sources: Colagrossi 等 - 2021

navigation.zh: 链接自主星际卫星轨道导航
navigation.definition_zh: 利用卫星间测距链路，在三体系统非对称重力场中确定卫星绝对轨道的自主导航技术。需至少一颗卫星部署在三体系统的非对称重力场中（如晕轨道），利用非对称性打破二体系统的对称性，使绝对轨道定向可解。
navigation.definition_en: Linked Autonomous Interplanetary Satellite Orbit Navigation; an autonomous navigation technique that uses satellite-to-satellite tracking range measurements to determine absolute orbital states in a three-body system's asymmetric gravity field, requiring at least one satellite deployed in the asymmetric region.
sources: Wang 等 - 2019 - Joint navigation performance of distant retrograde orbits and cislunar orbits via LiAISON

navigation.definition_zh: 卫星之间的测距技术，通过测量信号从一颗卫星到另一颗卫星的传播时间来获取卫星间距离或距离率信息。
navigation.definition_en: Satellite-to-Satellite Tracking; a measurement technique that obtains range or range-rate information between satellites by measuring the signal propagation time from one satellite to another.
sources: Wang 等 - 2019 - Joint navigation performance of distant retrograde orbits and cislunar orbits via LiAISON

navigation.definition_zh: 时钟误差中可由确定性多项式模型描述的部分，通常用二次多项式表示，包含时钟偏置、频漂和老化的综合效应。
navigation.definition_en: Deterministic Clock Error; the portion of clock error describable by a deterministic polynomial model, typically expressed as a second-order polynomial incorporating clock bias, drift, and aging effects.
sources: Wang 等 - 2019 - Joint navigation performance of distant retrograde orbits and cislunar orbits via LiAISON

navigation.definition_zh: 时钟误差中不可预测的随机成分，具有时间相关性，无法通过确定性模型完全吸收，是限制导航精度的主要因素之一。
navigation.definition_en: Stochastic Clock Error; the unpredictable random component of clock error with time-correlation that cannot be fully absorbed by deterministic models, one of the main factors limiting navigation accuracy.
sources: Wang 等 - 2019 - Joint navigation performance of distant retrograde orbits and cislunar orbits via LiAISON

navigation.definition_zh: 卫星间通过测距信号实现的时间对齐精度，本文研究表明基于DRO卫星的LiAISON系统可达到优于100纳秒的时间同步精度。
navigation.definition_en: Time Synchronization Accuracy; the precision of time alignment between satellites achieved through ranging signals; this paper shows that a DRO-based LiAISON system can achieve time synchronization accuracy better than 100 nanoseconds.
sources: Wang 等 - 2019 - Joint navigation performance of distant retrograde orbits and cislunar orbits via LiAISON

navigation.definition_zh: 扩展卡尔曼滤波中用于补偿未建模动力学误差的噪声矩阵，对角矩阵，其元素大小取决于未建模误差的量级，用于防止状态协方差矩阵过快收缩。
navigation.definition_en: State Noise Compensation Matrix; a noise matrix in the Extended Kalman Filter used to compensate for unmodeled dynamic errors, diagonal matrix whose elements depend on the magnitude of unmodeled errors, used to prevent the state covariance matrix from collapsing too rapidly.
sources: Wang 等 - 2019 - Joint navigation performance of distant retrograde orbits and cislunar orbits via LiAISON

navigation.definition_zh: 引导追踪星在预定时间内到达目标星并建立相对位置的制导方法。在地月空间三体问题背景下，需采用线性化方程或伴随法等特殊技术处理时变相对动力学。
navigation.definition_en: Guidance methods that direct a chaser spacecraft to reach a target and establish a relative position within a predetermined time. In the cislunar three-body problem context, special techniques such as linearized equations or adjoint methods are needed to handle time-varying relative dynamics.
sources: Bucchioni和Innocenti - 2021 - Rendezvous in Cis-Lunar Space near Rectilinear Halo Orbit Dynamics and Control Issues

navigation.definition_zh: 交会过程中设置的中间停止点，追踪星到达后暂停并检查状态。等待点的设置基于被动安全原则，位于稳定流形上以确保即使失控也不会与目标碰撞。
navigation.definition_en: Intermediate stopping points set during the rendezvous process where the chaser pauses and checks its state. Hold points are selected based on passive safety principles, located on stable manifolds to ensure that even loss of control won't cause collision with the target.
sources: Bucchioni和Innocenti - 2021 - Rendezvous in Cis-Lunar Space near Rectilinear Halo Orbit Dynamics and Control Issues

navigation.definition_zh: 追踪星接近目标后，通过机械接口实现物理连接的过程。与交会对接中的「对接」不同，停靠更强调追踪星被目标捕获后固定在指定位置的动作。
navigation.definition_en: The process of achieving physical connection through mechanical interfaces after the chaser approaches the target. Unlike docking in rendezvous and docking, berthing emphasizes the chaser being captured by the target and fixed in a designated position.
sources: Bucchioni和Innocenti - 2021 - Rendezvous in Cis-Lunar Space near Rectilinear Halo Orbit Dynamics and Control Issues

navigation.definition_zh: 航天器交会对接中的三大核心功能：制导确定飞行轨迹、导航提供状态估计、控制执行姿态与轨道机动。
navigation.definition_en: Guidance, Navigation and Control; core functions in spacecraft rendezvous: guidance determines trajectory, navigation provides state estimation, control executes maneuvers.

navigation.definition_zh: 利用相对测量估计多个航天器绝对状态的导航方法，观察者和目标同时估计，不依赖外部轨道确定。
navigation.definition_en: A navigation method that estimates the absolute state of multiple spacecraft using relative measurements, where both observer and target are estimated simultaneously without relying on external orbit determination.
sources: Autonomous Optical-Only Spacecraft-to-Spacecraft Absolute Tracking and Maneuver Classification in Cislunar Space

navigation.definition_zh: 通过动态链接测量更新与最优控制估计来处理未建模动力学和机动检测的滤波器，能够在单一线性滤波器内重建未建模事件。
navigation.definition_en: A filter that links measurement updates with optimal control estimation to handle unmodeled dynamics and maneuver detection, capable of reconstructing unmodeled events within a single linear filter.
sources: Autonomous Optical-Only Spacecraft-to-Spacecraft Absolute Tracking and Maneuver Classification in Cislunar Space

navigation.definition_zh: 将无迹卡尔曼滤波与最优控制估计相结合的处理非线性非平稳机动的滤波器。
navigation.definition_en: A filter combining unscented Kalman filtering with optimal control based estimation to handle nonlinear unmodeled maneuvers.
sources: Autonomous Optical-Only Spacecraft-to-Spacecraft Absolute Tracking and Maneuver Classification in Cislunar Space

navigation.definition_zh: 通过核函数将输入数据投影到可分超平面空间进行分类的机器学习算法。
navigation.definition_en: A machine learning algorithm that projects input data into a space where it is easily separable by a hyperplane using a kernel function.
sources: Autonomous Optical-Only Spacecraft-to-Spacecraft Absolute Tracking and Maneuver Classification in Cislunar Space

navigation.definition_zh: 根据估计的控制档案识别航天器行为类型的任务，包括无机动、轨道保持、轨道离开和通用机动。
navigation.definition_en: The task of identifying types of spacecraft behavior from estimated control profiles, including no maneuver, station keeping, orbit departure, and general maneuver.
sources: Autonomous Optical-Only Spacecraft-to-Spacecraft Absolute Tracking and Maneuver Classification in Cislunar Space

navigation.definition_zh: 识别航天器是否执行机动的过程，是鲁棒跟踪解决方案的关键能力。
navigation.definition_en: The process of identifying whether a spacecraft has executed a maneuver, a critical capability for robust tracking solutions.
sources: Autonomous Optical-Only Spacecraft-to-Spacecraft Absolute Tracking and Maneuver Classification in Cislunar Space

navigation.definition_zh: 基于估计控制积分与流形几何关系的多分类器，利用U-OCBE准确的事件重建能力。
navigation.definition_en: A multi-classifier based on the geometric relationship between estimated control integral and manifolds, leveraging the accurate event reconstruction capability of U-OCBE.
sources: Autonomous Optical-Only Spacecraft-to-Spacecraft Absolute Tracking and Maneuver Classification in Cislunar Space

navigation.definition_zh: 估计控制政策的积分，代表施加到系统的总估计控制量，用于分类器输入。
navigation.definition_en: The integral of the estimated control policy, representing the total estimated effort applied to the system, used as classifier input.
sources: Autonomous Optical-Only Spacecraft-to-Spacecraft Absolute Tracking and Maneuver Classification in Cislunar Space

navigation.en: Radial Basis Function Kernel, RBF Kernel
navigation.definition_zh: SVM中作为相似度度量的核函数。
navigation.definition_en: A kernel function in SVM that acts as a similarity measure.
sources: Autonomous Optical-Only Spacecraft-to-Spacecraft Absolute Tracking and Maneuver Classification in Cislunar Space

navigation.definition_zh: 基于估计控制积分与稳定/不稳定流形夹角的分类方法。
navigation.definition_en: A classification method based on the angle between the estimated control integral and stable/unstable manifolds.
sources: Autonomous Optical-Only Spacecraft-to-Spacecraft Absolute Tracking and Maneuver Classification in Cislunar Space

navigation.definition_zh: 利用加权最小二乘法将位置观测与轨道初轨相结合，通过迭代求解轨道状态估值的微分修正方法。
navigation.definition_en: A differential correction method that uses weighted least-squares to estimate orbital state by iteratively solving position observations combined with initial orbit.
sources: Uncertain Lambert Problem

navigation.definition_zh: 利用光学传感器获取目标图像，通过特征点检测和姿态估计实现相对状态测量
navigation.definition_en: Navigation using optical sensors to capture target images, achieving relative state measurement through feature point detection and pose estimation
sources: Rendezvous in cislunar halo orbits: Hardware-in-the-loop simulation with coupled orbit and attitude dynamics

navigation.definition_zh: 基于 Perspective-n-Points 问题的闭式求解器，将三维-二维对应点关系转化为位姿估计
navigation.definition_en: Closed-form solver for the Perspective-n-Points problem, converting 3D-2D point correspondences into pose estimation
sources: Rendezvous in cislunar halo orbits: Hardware-in-the-loop simulation with coupled orbit and attitude dynamics

navigation.definition_zh: 通过滤波器（如卡尔曼滤波）处理观测数据，获得系统状态的最优估计
navigation.definition_en: Obtaining optimal estimation of system states through filtering (e.g., Kalman filter) processing observed data
sources: Rendezvous in cislunar halo orbits: Hardware-in-the-loop simulation with coupled orbit and attitude dynamics

navigation.definition_zh: 确定追踪航天器相对目标的位置与姿态
navigation.definition_en: Determining the position and attitude of the chaser relative to the target
sources: Rendezvous in cislunar halo orbits: Hardware-in-the-loop simulation with coupled orbit and attitude dynamics

navigation.definition_zh: 高效的n点透视位姿估计算法
navigation.definition_en: Efficient algorithm for pose estimation from n perspective points
sources: Rendezvous in cislunar halo orbits: Hardware-in-the-loop simulation with coupled orbit and attitude dynamics

navigation.definition_zh: 以雅可比常数为坐标轴，展示两轨道间估计速度增量的可视化工具。
navigation.definition_en: A visualization tool with Jacobi Constant as axes, showing the estimated delta-V between two orbits.
sources: Waldecker & Howell 2025

navigation.zh: 相位 inform 转移设计
navigation.definition_zh: 利用流形弧轨迹构建热图并结合相位约束来估计长距离交会转移成本的设计方法。
navigation.definition_en: A transfer design approach that uses manifold arc trajectories to construct heat maps and incorporates phasing constraints to estimate long-range rendezvous transfer costs.
sources: Waldecker & Howell 2025

navigation.definition_zh: 航天器不依赖地面指挥自主完成轨道交会、接近和对接的过程，是未来高频率空间任务的关键使能技术。
navigation.definition_en: The capability for highly reliable, autonomous rendezvous, proximity operations, and capture/attachment to free-flying space objects, cooperative or non-cooperative.
sources: Starek 等 - 2016 - Spacecraft autonomy challenges for next-generation space missions

navigation.definition_zh: 航天器自主接近、检查和维护在轨目标的技术，对延长卫星寿命和降低任务成本具有重要意义。
navigation.definition_en: Autonomous proximity operations for inspecting and servicing spacecraft or space objects, aimed at extending satellite lifespan and reducing mission costs.
sources: Starek 等 - 2016 - Spacecraft autonomy challenges for next-generation space missions

navigation.definition_zh: 确定移动平台在目标天体表面位置和姿态的过程，在非映射环境（如小天体）中尤为挑战。
navigation.definition_en: Determination of a mobile platform's position and orientation on a celestial body surface; particularly challenging in unmapped environments such as small bodies.
sources: Starek 等 - 2016 - Spacecraft autonomy challenges for next-generation space missions

navigation.definition_zh: 精度优于百米的着陆技术，是未来极端地形探测的关键使能技术，可显著减少地面机动距离需求。
navigation.definition_en: Landing accuracy within 100 meters; key enabling technology for future extreme terrain exploration, significantly reducing ground traverse distance requirements.
sources: Starek 等 - 2016 - Spacecraft autonomy challenges for next-generation space missions

navigation.definition_zh: 利用目标位置估计序列和轨道动力学模型（如Hill方程）估计目标相对轨道参数的过程。
navigation.definition_en: The process of estimating the relative orbital parameters of a target using a sequence of position estimates and orbital dynamics models (e.g., Hill's equations).

navigation.definition_zh: 一种递归最优估计方法，用于实时更新航天器轨道状态。包含线性卡尔曼滤波、扩展卡尔曼滤波（EKF）和无迹卡尔曼滤波（UKF）等变体，广泛用于轨道确定和导航。
navigation.definition_en: A recursive optimal estimation method that recursively estimates satellite orbit, clock difference, and other parameters through state equations and observation equations. Kalman filtering is suitable for real-time orbit determination and is the core algorithm for real-time orbit determination in navigation systems.
sources: 肖峰 - 1989 - 球面天文学与天体力学基础
王小亚 等 - 2017 - 导航卫星精密定轨技术
Vallado - 2022 - Fundamentals of astrodynamics and applications

navigation.definition_zh: 控制和引导航天器沿预定轨道飞行的技术
navigation.definition_en: Technology for controlling and guiding spacecraft to fly along predetermined trajectory
sources: 任萱 - 1988 - 人造地球卫星轨道力学

navigation.definition_zh: 航天器飞行末段使用的制导方法
navigation.definition_en: Guidance method used in terminal phase of spacecraft flight
sources: 任萱 - 1988 - 人造地球卫星轨道力学

navigation.definition_zh: 目标视线方向变化的角速度
navigation.definition_en: Angular velocity of line-of-sight direction change to target
sources: 任萱 - 1988 - 人造地球卫星轨道力学

navigation.definition_zh: 基于对作用于卫星上作用力的清晰了解和力学模型的精准模制，建立卫星的动力学和运动学方程，通过解算初始历元轨道参数和动力学模型参数达到精密定轨目的的方法。力学模型越精确，定轨精度越高。
navigation.definition_en: A method of precise orbit determination based on clear understanding of forces acting on satellites and precise modeling of dynamics. By establishing satellite dynamics and kinematics equations and solving initial epoch orbital parameters and dynamic model parameters, the purpose of precise orbit determination is achieved. The more precise the mechanical model, the higher the orbit determination accuracy.
sources: 王小亚 等 - 2017 - 导航卫星精密定轨技术

navigation.definition_zh: 利用航天器所带接收机得到的导航卫星观测数据，通过同时观测4颗以上卫星进行绝对单点定位，得到航天器位置以确定卫星轨道的方法。该方法完全独立于力学模型，仅依靠卫星测量精度和观测卫星的数目及几何构型。
navigation.definition_en: A method of determining satellite orbit by using navigation satellite observation data from the spacecraft receiver to perform absolute single-point positioning by simultaneously observing 4 or more satellites to obtain the spacecraft position. This method is completely independent of the mechanical model and only relies on satellite measurement accuracy and the number and geometric configuration of observed satellites.
sources: 王小亚 等 - 2017 - 导航卫星精密定轨技术

navigation.definition_zh: 对动力学模型采取放松和简化，依靠估计经验参数来吸收由力学模型不准确而引起的误差的定轨方法。其中估计的动力学参数和三个方向的经验力（沿迹、法向和径向）可根据实际定轨情况进行调整。
navigation.definition_en: An orbit determination method that relaxes and simplifies the dynamic model, relying on estimating empirical parameters to absorb errors caused by inaccurate mechanical models. The estimated dynamic parameters and empirical forces in three directions (along-track, normal, and radial) can be adjusted according to actual orbit determination conditions.
sources: 王小亚 等 - 2017 - 导航卫星精密定轨技术

navigation.definition_zh: 利用纯几何法定轨的结果和先验轨道的绝对约束产生的不同历元间的三维相对位置，来减少几何构型差和相位跳变引起的定位结果异常，达到稳定和平滑定轨目的的方法。其定轨结果依赖先验轨道的选取。
navigation.definition_en: A method that uses pure geometric orbit determination results and three-dimensional relative positions between different epochs generated by absolute constraints of prior orbits to reduce positioning result anomalies caused by geometric configuration differences and phase jumps, achieving stable and smooth orbit determination. The orbit determination results depend on the selection of prior orbits.
sources: 王小亚 等 - 2017 - 导航卫星精密定轨技术

navigation.definition_zh: 联合利用地面跟踪站观测数据和星间链路测量数据进行导航卫星精密定轨的方法。可提高定轨精度和可靠性，是北斗系统二期实现高精度定轨的关键技术之一。
navigation.definition_en: A method of precise navigation satellite orbit determination by jointly using ground tracking station observation data and inter-satellite link measurement data. It can improve orbit determination accuracy and reliability, and is one of the key technologies for achieving high-precision orbit determination in the BeiDou Phase II system.
sources: 王小亚 等 - 2017 - 导航卫星精密定轨技术

navigation.definition_zh: 仅依靠星间链路测量数据，不依赖或少量依赖地面站数据进行的导航卫星精密定轨方法。是实现导航卫星自主导航的核心技术，可显著增强系统的自主运行能力。
navigation.definition_en: A method of precise navigation satellite orbit determination that only relies on inter-satellite link measurement data, with little or no dependence on ground station data. It is the core technology for achieving autonomous navigation of navigation satellites, significantly enhancing the system's autonomous operation capability.
sources: 王小亚 等 - 2017 - 导航卫星精密定轨技术

navigation.definition_zh: 导航卫星不依赖地面系统，仅依靠星间链路测量和星载原子钟自主维持时间基准，实现轨道确定和导航服务的能力。是导航系统实现全球覆盖和自主运行的关键技术。
navigation.definition_en: The capability of navigation satellites to maintain orbit determination and navigation services independently without relying on ground systems, solely depending on inter-satellite link measurements and onboard atomic clocks to autonomously maintain the time reference. It is a key technology for navigation systems to achieve global coverage and autonomous operation.
sources: 王小亚 等 - 2017 - 导航卫星精密定轨技术

navigation.definition_zh: 卫星轨道机动后，在短时间内重新确定高精度轨道的快速定轨技术。北斗系统设计轨道机动后8小时定轨精度优于30米，对导航系统的服务连续性至关重要。
navigation.definition_en: A rapid orbit determination technology that re-determines high-precision orbits in a short time after satellite orbit maneuvers. The BeiDou system is designed to achieve orbit determination accuracy better than 30 meters within 8 hours after orbit maneuvers, which is crucial for the continuity of the navigation system's services.
sources: 王小亚 等 - 2017 - 导航卫星精密定轨技术

navigation.definition_zh: 利用少量观测数据确定卫星初始轨道的初轨确定方法。常用非线性化Bancroft算法等，通过同时观测4颗以上已知位置卫星来确定卫星轨道和钟差。
navigation.definition_en: Methods for determining satellite initial orbits using a small amount of observation data. Nonlinear Bancroft algorithm and similar methods are commonly used to determine satellite orbits and clock differences by simultaneously observing 4 or more satellites with known positions.
sources: 王小亚 等 - 2017 - 导航卫星精密定轨技术

navigation.definition_zh: 载波相位观测中整周模糊度的确定过程。模糊度固定是实现高精度相对定位和精密定轨的关键步骤，常用LAMBDA方法等进行整周模糊度的搜索与固定。
navigation.definition_en: The process of determining integer ambiguities in carrier phase observations. Ambiguity resolution is a key step for achieving high-precision relative positioning and precise orbit determination. LAMBDA method and similar approaches are commonly used for integer ambiguity search and resolution.
sources: 王小亚 等 - 2017 - 导航卫星精密定轨技术

navigation.definition_zh: 检测载波相位观测值中整周计数中断的技术。常用的周跳探测方法包括TECR法、MW法、双差观测值探测法等。周跳会严重影响定轨精度，必须准确探测并修复。
navigation.definition_en: Techniques for detecting interruptions in integer cycle counting of carrier phase observations. Common cycle slip detection methods include TECR method, MW method, and double-difference observation detection methods. Cycle slips seriously affect orbit determination accuracy and must be accurately detected and repaired.
sources: 王小亚 等 - 2017 - 导航卫星精密定轨技术

navigation.definition_zh: 修正卫星或接收机天线相位中心与几何中心之间偏差的模型。天线相位中心改正精度直接影响伪距和相位观测值的质量，是精密定轨误差源之一。
navigation.definition_en: Models that correct deviations between the antenna phase center and geometric center of satellites or receivers. Antenna phase center correction accuracy directly affects the quality of pseudorange and carrier phase observations, and is one of the orbit determination error sources.
sources: 王小亚 等 - 2017 - 导航卫星精密定轨技术

navigation.definition_zh: 导航信号不同频率或不同码通道之间的硬件延迟差异。码偏差会导致伪距观测值系统误差，需要在数据处理中进行估计和改正，以实现多系统融合定轨。
navigation.definition_en: Hardware delay differences between different frequencies or different code channels of navigation signals. Code bias causes systematic errors in pseudorange observations and needs to be estimated and corrected in data processing to achieve multi-system joint orbit determination.
sources: 王小亚 等 - 2017 - 导航卫星精密定轨技术

navigation.definition_zh: 导航信号经过反射后与直接信号叠加产生的干涉效应。多路径效应会导致伪距和相位观测值出现系统性偏差，是影响精密定轨精度的重要因素。
navigation.definition_en: Interference effects caused by navigation signals being superimposed with direct signals after reflection. Multipath effect causes systematic deviations in pseudorange and carrier phase observations, and is an important factor affecting precise orbit determination accuracy.
sources: 王小亚 等 - 2017 - 导航卫星精密定轨技术

navigation.definition_zh: 将精密确定的轨道和钟差参数拟合成导航电文格式的过程。不同类型卫星（GEO/IGSO/MEO）由于轨道特性差异，电文拟合方法有所不同，北斗系统需处理与GPS不同的特殊情况。
navigation.definition_en: The process of fitting precisely determined orbit and clock difference parameters into navigation message formats. Different types of satellites (GEO/IGSO/MEO) have different orbit characteristics, so navigation message fitting methods vary. The BeiDou system needs to handle special cases different from GPS.
sources: 王小亚 等 - 2017 - 导航卫星精密定轨技术

navigation.definition_zh: 同时利用一段观测弧段内的所有观测数据，通过最小二乘平差求解卫星轨道和钟差等参数的方法。批处理可充分利用观测数据冗余度，获得最优解。
navigation.definition_en: A method that simultaneously uses all observation data within an observation arc to solve satellite orbit, clock difference, and other parameters through least squares adjustment. Batch processing can fully utilize observation data redundancy to obtain optimal solutions.
sources: 王小亚 等 - 2017 - 导航卫星精密定轨技术

navigation.definition_zh: 在最小二乘平差中利用已知的先验信息（如先前历元的轨道、测站坐标等）对待估参数进行约束的条件。先验约束可以提高参数估计的稳定性和精度。
navigation.definition_en: Conditions that constrain parameters to be estimated using known prior information (such as orbits from previous epochs, station coordinates, etc.) in least squares adjustment. A priori constraints can improve the stability and accuracy of parameter estimation.
sources: 王小亚 等 - 2017 - 导航卫星精密定轨技术

navigation.definition_zh: 导航卫星星载原子钟与标准时间的偏差。卫星钟差是GNSS定位的主要误差源之一，高精度定轨需要精确估计和改正钟差信息。
navigation.definition_en: The deviation between the atomic clock onboard a navigation satellite and the standard time. Satellite clock bias is one of the main error sources in GNSS positioning, and high-precision orbit determination requires accurate estimation and correction of clock bias information.
sources: 王小亚 等 - 2017 - 导航卫星精密定轨技术

navigation.definition_zh: GNSS接收机内部时钟与标准时间的偏差。接收机钟差通常作为未知参数在数据处理中一并估计，对于单点定位尤为重要。
navigation.definition_en: The deviation between the internal clock of a GNSS receiver and the standard time. Receiver clock bias is usually estimated as an unknown parameter in data processing, and is particularly important for single-point positioning.
sources: 王小亚 等 - 2017 - 导航卫星精密定轨技术

navigation.definition_zh: GNSS接收机跟踪的卫星载波信号相位。载波相位测量精度可达毫米级，但包含整周模糊度，需要经过模糊度固定才能获得高精度距离信息。
navigation.definition_en: The carrier signal phase tracked by GNSS receivers from satellites. Carrier phase measurement accuracy can reach millimeter level, but contains integer ambiguity, and high-precision distance information can only be obtained after ambiguity resolution.
sources: 王小亚 等 - 2017 - 导航卫星精密定轨技术

navigation.definition_zh: 两个测站对同一卫星同步观测求差的 GNSS 数据处理方法。单差可以消除卫星钟差，是双差和三差观测的基础。
navigation.definition_en: A GNSS data processing method that obtains differences between simultaneous observations of the same satellite by two stations. Single-difference can eliminate satellite clock bias and is the basis for double-difference and triple-difference observations.
sources: 王小亚 等 - 2017 - 导航卫星精密定轨技术

navigation.definition_zh: 在单差基础上进一步对两颗卫星求差的GNSS数据处理方法。双差可以同时消除卫星钟差和接收机钟差，是相对定位和精密定轨的主要观测形式。
navigation.definition_en: A GNSS data processing method that further obtains differences between two satellites on the basis of single-difference. Double-difference can simultaneously eliminate satellite clock bias and receiver clock bias, and is the main observation form for relative positioning and precise orbit determination.
sources: 王小亚 等 - 2017 - 导航卫星精密定轨技术

navigation.definition_zh: 国际GNSS服务组织（IGS）提供的高精度卫星轨道、钟差、地球自转参数等产品。IGS产品包括超快、快速和最终产品，精度从分米到厘米级不等。
navigation.definition_en: High-precision satellite orbit, clock difference, Earth rotation parameter and other products provided by the International GNSS Service (IGS). IGS products include ultra-rapid, rapid, and final products with accuracy ranging from decimeter to centimeter level.
sources: 王小亚 等 - 2017 - 导航卫星精密定轨技术

navigation.definition_zh: 通过测量航天器相对于恒星或其他天体的角度来确定位置和速度的自主导航技术，包括星图识别、星光折射敏感等技术。
navigation.definition_en: Autonomous navigation technique that determines spacecraft position and velocity by measuring angles relative to stars or celestial bodies, including star pattern recognition and stellar occultation sensing.
sources: 利用拉格朗日点的深空探测技术

navigation.definition_zh: 通过匹配星敏感器拍摄的星图与已知星表来确定航天器姿态的技术，是自主天文导航的关键环节。
navigation.definition_en: Technique for determining spacecraft attitude by matching star patterns captured by star trackers with known star catalogs, crucial for autonomous celestial navigation.
sources: 利用拉格朗日点的深空探测技术

navigation.definition_zh: 利用地标数据库和姿态信息计算飞行器在参考坐标系中的绝对位置
navigation.definition_en: Computing the absolute position of a spacecraft in a reference frame using landmark database and attitude information

navigation.definition_zh: 月球着陆任务中依靠视觉导航的关键阶段
navigation.definition_en: Critical phase in lunar landing missions relying on vision-based navigation

navigation.definition_zh: 月球着陆任务中利用主发动机进行减速的阶段
navigation.definition_en: Phase in lunar landing missions using main engine for deceleration

navigation.definition_zh: 月球着陆的最后垂直下降阶段
navigation.definition_en: Final vertical descent phase of lunar landing

navigation.definition_zh: 确保安全着陆的飞行路径可行区域
navigation.definition_en: Feasible flight path region ensuring safe landing

navigation.definition_zh: 仅利用目标相对角度测量进行状态估计的导航方法
navigation.definition_en: Navigation method using only relative angle measurements to target for state estimation

navigation.definition_zh: 以螺旋轨迹接近目标航天器的交会对接策略
navigation.definition_en: Rendezvous and docking strategy approaching target spacecraft with spiral trajectory

navigation.definition_zh: 确定两个航天器之间相对位置和速度的技术
navigation.definition_en: Technology for determining relative position and velocity between two spacecraft

navigation.definition_zh: 利用GPS或雷达等确定航天器在惯性坐标系中绝对位置的技术
navigation.definition_en: Technology for determining absolute spacecraft position in inertial frame using GPS or radar

navigation.definition_zh: 单纯角度导航中相对几何构型不变导致测距精度无法改善的问题
navigation.definition_en: Problem in angles-only navigation where relative geometry invariance prevents range accuracy improvement

navigation.definition_zh: 将多个传感器各自生成的航迹估计进行融合的分布式估计架构
navigation.definition_en: A distributed estimation architecture that fuses track estimates generated independently by multiple sensors

navigation.definition_zh: 一种带记忆的航迹融合特例，在实际跟踪场景中具有一致且接近最优的融合性能
navigation.definition_en: A special case of track-to-track fusion with memory that exhibits consistent and near-optimal fusion performance in practical tracking scenarios

navigation.definition_zh: 描述两个航迹估计之间相关性的协方差矩阵，是航迹融合的关键量
navigation.definition_en: Covariance matrix describing the correlation between two track estimates, a key quantity in track-to-track fusion

navigation.definition_zh: 将延迟量测从其产生时刻传送到当前时刻进行融合的算法，避免迭代重算
navigation.definition_en: Algorithm that transports delayed measurements from their generation time to current time for fusion, avoiding iterative recomputation

navigation.definition_zh: 在分布式传感器网络中处理到达延迟不同的量测的数据融合方法
navigation.definition_en: Data fusion method for processing measurements that arrive with different delays in distributed sensor networks

navigation.definition_zh: 各传感器节点独立运行卡尔曼滤波器并交换信息以实现网络级状态估计的架构
navigation.definition_en: Architecture where each sensor node runs an independent Kalman filter and exchanges information to achieve network-level state estimation

navigation.definition_zh: 利用地面跟踪站（雷达、光学等）测量数据确定航天器位置和速度的导航方式
navigation.definition_en: Navigation method that uses ground tracking station measurements (radar, optical, etc.) to determine spacecraft position and velocity

navigation.definition_zh: 仅凭角度量测能否唯一确定目标距离的特性
navigation.definition_en: Property of whether target range can be uniquely determined from angle measurements alone

navigation.definition_zh: 利用已知参考姿态信息确定惯性导航系统安装姿态的机载对准方法
navigation.definition_en: On-board alignment method that determines INS installation attitude using known reference attitude information

navigation.definition_zh: 利用Saastamoinen模型对对流层引起的测距和测角误差进行修正
navigation.definition_en: Correction of range and angle measurement errors caused by troposphere using Saastamoinen model

navigation.definition_zh: 利用双频量测消除电离层引起的信号延迟误差
navigation.definition_en: Elimination of ionospheric signal delay errors using dual-frequency measurements

navigation.definition_zh: 考虑电磁波有限传播速度引起的时间延迟的量测修正
navigation.definition_en: Measurement correction accounting for time delay caused by finite speed of electromagnetic wave propagation

navigation.definition_zh: 将多个传感器（太阳敏感器、地平仪、陀螺仪等）的四元数姿态估计进行最优融合
navigation.definition_en: Optimal fusion of quaternion attitude estimates from multiple sensors (sun sensors, horizon sensors, gyros, etc.)

navigation.definition_zh: 传感器量测中出现的异常，如噪声突增或传感器完全失效
navigation.definition_en: Anomaly in sensor measurements such as noise spikes or complete sensor failure

navigation.definition_zh: 机器人在未知环境中同时估计自身位置并构建环境地图的技术
navigation.definition_en: Technique where a robot simultaneously estimates its position and constructs an environmental map in an unknown environment

navigation.definition_zh: 利用三个位置矢量确定轨道根数的方法。
navigation.definition_en: A method for determining orbital elements using three position vectors.
sources: 轨道力学 第5章

navigation.definition_zh: 利用角度和距离观测数据确定轨道根数的方法。
navigation.definition_en: A method for determining orbital elements using angular and distance observation data.
sources: 轨道力学 第5章

navigation.definition_zh: 以地面测站为原点的坐标系。
navigation.definition_en: A coordinate system with the ground station as the origin.
sources: 轨道力学 第5章

navigation.definition_zh: 以测站为中心，参考面为当地水平面的坐标系。
navigation.definition_en: A coordinate system centered at the station with the local horizontal plane as reference.
sources: 轨道力学 第5章

navigation.definition_zh: 根据初始条件和动力学模型预测航天器未来位置和速度的过程。
navigation.definition_en: Process of predicting a spacecraft's future position and velocity based on initial conditions and dynamic models.
sources: Vepa - 2024 - Space vehicle maneuvering, propulsion, dynamics and control

navigation.definition_zh: 利用天体位置观测确定航天器在星际空间中的位置和速度的技术。
navigation.definition_en: Technique of determining spacecraft position and velocity in interplanetary space by observing celestial body positions.
sources: Vepa - 2024 - Space vehicle maneuvering, propulsion, dynamics and control

navigation.definition_zh: 根据剩余速度增量进行制导的方法，通过比较实际速度与标称速度差值确定推力方向，是有限推力轨道机动的常用制导策略。
navigation.definition_en: Guidance method based on remaining velocity increment, determining thrust direction by comparing actual and nominal velocity differences, a common guidance strategy for finite-thrust orbital maneuvers.
sources: 张洪波 - 2015 - 航天器轨道力学理论与方法

navigation.definition_zh: 在飞行过程中迭代求解最优控制问题的制导方法，通过不断更新协态变量估计来逼近最优解。
navigation.definition_en: Guidance method that iteratively solves optimal control problems during flight, approaching optimal solutions by continuously updating co-state variable estimates.
sources: 张洪波 - 2015 - 航天器轨道力学理论与方法

navigation.definition_zh: 一种速度增益制导方法，以剩余速度矢量方向为控制目标，通过解析计算给出推力方向。
navigation.definition_en: A velocity-to-be-gained guidance method targeting the remaining velocity vector direction as the control objective, determining thrust direction through analytical computation.
sources: 张洪波 - 2015 - 航天器轨道力学理论与方法

navigation.definition_zh: 通过测量天体之间的夹角确定飞行器位置和速度的导航方法，阿波罗任务中利用空间六分仪测量恒星与天体之间的角度进行天文定位。
navigation.definition_en: Navigation method determining spacecraft position and velocity by measuring angular separations between celestial bodies; Apollo missions used space sextants to measure angles between stars and planetary targets.
sources: 航天动力学的数学方法（修订版）/Richard H. Battin - 2018 - 航天动力学的数学方法（修订版）.md

other.definition_zh: Dorigo等人提出的群智能元启发式优化算法。模拟蚂蚁觅食行为：一组搜索个体在解空间中同时探索，通过信息素浓度引导后续搜索方向；局部搜索完成后进行全局信息素更新，使搜索逐步收敛到最优解。适用于多参数、非线性、带约束的复杂优化问题。
other.definition_en: A swarm-intelligence metaheuristic optimization algorithm proposed by Dorigo et al. A population of search agents explores the solution space simultaneously, guided by pheromone intensity deposited by predecessors; after local searches are complete, global pheromone updates steer the population toward the optimum. Applicable to multi-parameter, nonlinear, constrained optimization problems.
sources: Halo轨道的航天器编队构型设计

other.en: Integrated Communication, Navigation and Remote Sensing
other.definition_zh: 将通信、导航、遥感功能集成于同一卫星或卫星网络的基础设施设计理念。论文建议在环月轨道、地月拉格朗日点、远距离逆行轨道等战略点位部署通导遥卫星或载荷，构建地月空间信息控制中枢。
other.definition_en: An infrastructure design philosophy that integrates communication, navigation, and remote sensing functions into the same satellite or satellite network. The paper proposes deploying such integrated satellites at strategic locations including lunar orbits, Earth-Moon Lagrange points, and DRO to build a cislunar information hub.
sources: 何熊文 等 - 2024 - 地月空间态势感知与应对策略研究

other.definition_zh: 部署在地月空间多种轨道上的卫星组网系统，为月球探测活动提供通信和导航服务。论文设计的最终构型为「2颗南半球NRHO+2颗北半球NRHO+8颗ELFO+10颗DRO」共22颗卫星，可实现全月面100%四重连续覆盖。
other.definition_en: A satellite network system deployed across multiple orbits in cislunar space to provide communication and navigation services for lunar exploration activities. The paper's final configuration is 22 satellites ('2 southern NRHO + 2 northern NRHO + 8 ELFO + 10 DRO'), achieving 100% quadruple continuous coverage of the full lunar surface.
sources: Zhang 等 - 2025 - Cislunar space constellation design for future lunar resource development and utilization

other.definition_zh: 搭载在嫦娥4号着陆器上重3 kg的密封圆柱形科普载荷，内含植物种子（暂定马铃薯）和昆虫卵（暂定家蚕），构成简单生态系统。通过顶部光导管引入太阳光提供植物光合作用能源，聚酯薄膜保温层和半导体冷热片实现温度控制，锂硫特种电池配合着陆器供电实现昼夜连续供电。验证月面太阳自然光照下植物光合作用原理和月面低重力下动植物生长状况。
other.definition_en: A 3 kg sealed cylindrical public engagement payload carried on the Chang'e-4 lander, containing plant seeds (tentatively potato) and insect eggs (tentatively silkworm) forming a simple ecosystem. A light guide tube at the top introduces sunlight for photosynthesis, polyester film insulation and semiconductor thermoelectric coolers provide temperature control, and lithium-sulfur batteries combined with lander power supply enable continuous day-night power. It validates photosynthesis principles under natural lunar sunlight and plant/animal growth under lunar low-gravity conditions.
sources: 吴伟仁 等 - 2017 - 「嫦娥4号」月球背面软着陆任务设计

other.definition_zh: 利用放射性同位素（如238Pu）衰变产生的热量，通过热电偶的塞贝克效应将热能直接转换为电能的核电源装置。嫦娥4号着陆器采用基于238Pu同位素热源的RTG，在长达14 d的月夜期间提供不小于2.5 W的电功率，同时为舱内提供热能用于温度控制，解决了月夜无法使用太阳能时的供电难题。
other.definition_en: A nuclear power device that converts heat from radioactive isotope decay (such as 238Pu) directly into electricity through the Seebeck effect in thermocouples. The Chang'e-4 lander uses an RTG based on 238Pu, providing no less than 2.5 W of electrical power during the 14-day lunar night, while simultaneously providing thermal energy for cabin temperature control, solving the power supply challenge when solar energy is unavailable.
sources: 吴伟仁 等 - 2017 - 「嫦娥4号」月球背面软着陆任务设计

other.definition_zh: 物理系统的高保真数字复制品，用于仿真、预测和决策支持。论文提出构建地月空间态势感知的开源数字孪生平台，集成蒙特卡洛仿真与威胁推演，形成「感知—决策—响应」闭环体系。
other.definition_en: A high-fidelity digital replica of a physical system used for simulation, prediction, and decision support. The paper proposes building an open-source digital twin platform for cislunar SSA, integrating Monte Carlo simulation and threat assessment to form a closed-loop 'sense-decide-respond' system.
sources: 地月空间态势感知技术研究现状与发展

other.definition_zh: 通过回收和重复使用运载器来大幅降低发射成本的航天运输系统。全寿命周期成本由研制、制造、维护、回收、操作和其他六类费用构成，复用次数增加后单次发射成本持续下降，复用100次时总成本可降至一次性运载火箭的6%左右，下降一到两个量级。当前国际上SpaceX「猎鹰9号」已实现一子级多次复用，「超重-星舰」目标实现全箭复用。
other.definition_en: A launch system that achieves dramatic cost reduction through recovery and reuse of launch vehicle components. Life-cycle cost comprises six categories: development, manufacturing, maintenance, recovery, operations, and miscellaneous. As reuse count increases, per-launch cost decreases continuously; at 100 reuses, total cost drops to roughly 6% of an expendable vehicle, a reduction of one to two orders of magnitude. SpaceX's Falcon 9 has demonstrated multiple booster reuses, while Starship/Super Heavy targets full vehicle reuse.
sources: 大规模低成本地月空间航天运输体系研究

other.definition_zh: 采用垂直起飞、垂直着陆方式的可复用运载器。是当前国际可复用运载火箭的主流技术路线，SpaceX「猎鹰9号」和「新格伦」均采用此构型。在地月空间运输接力式方案中，VTVL是天地往返运输系统的候选方案之一。
other.definition_en: A reusable launch vehicle that takes off and lands vertically. This is the dominant configuration for current international reusable launch vehicles, adopted by SpaceX's Falcon 9 and Blue Origin's New Glenn. In the relay-style cislunar transportation architecture, VTVL is one of the candidate configurations for the Earth-to-orbit round-trip system.
sources: 大规模低成本地月空间航天运输体系研究

other.zh: 垂直起飞水平返回运载器
other.definition_zh: 采用垂直起飞、水平着陆方式的可复用运载器。发射段按传统火箭垂直起飞，返回段利用机翼气动升力滑翔水平着陆，类似航天飞机的返回方式。在地月空间运输接力式方案中是天地往返运输系统的候选方案之一。
other.definition_en: A reusable launch vehicle that takes off vertically and lands horizontally. During launch it follows a conventional vertical ascent; during return it uses aerodynamic wing lift to glide and land horizontally, similar to the Space Shuttle's reentry approach. It is one of the candidate configurations for the Earth-to-orbit round-trip system in the relay-style cislunar transportation architecture.
sources: 大规模低成本地月空间航天运输体系研究

other.definition_zh: 采用水平起飞、水平着陆方式的可复用运载器。类似常规航空飞行器的起降方式，可利用机场跑道操作，对基础设施要求较低。在地月空间运输接力式方案中是天地往返运输系统的候选方案之一。
other.definition_en: A reusable launch vehicle that takes off and lands horizontally. Similar to conventional aircraft operations, it can use airport runways, reducing infrastructure requirements. It is one of the candidate configurations for the Earth-to-orbit round-trip system in the relay-style cislunar transportation architecture.
sources: 大规模低成本地月空间航天运输体系研究

other.definition_zh: 地月空间航天运输体系的组成部分之一，负责地面与近地轨道之间人员和物资的往返运输。是整个运输体系的第一环，将有效载荷和推进剂送入近地轨道后与轨道转移级对接。发射能力需求达百吨级，发射频次达千次级/年。
other.definition_en: A component of the cislunar aerospace transportation system responsible for round-trip transport of crew and cargo between the ground and low Earth orbit. As the first link in the transportation chain, it delivers payloads and propellant to LEO for docking with the orbital transfer stage. Required launch capacity is on the order of 100 tons, with thousands of launches per year.
sources: 大规模低成本地月空间航天运输体系研究

other.definition_zh: 接力式方案中负责近地轨道与地月拉格朗日点之间轨道转移运输的专用飞行器。长期驻留在LEO加注站，在轨加注后将有效载荷和月面着陆上升器所需的推进剂运至EML1加注站，完成任务后返回LEO。可采用液氢液氧推进剂或大功率电推进，规模约65吨级。
other.definition_en: A dedicated spacecraft in the relay-style architecture responsible for orbital transfer between LEO and Earth-Moon Lagrange points. It permanently stations at the LEO depot, receives on-orbit propellant refueling, then transports payloads and propellant for the lunar lander/ascender to the EML1 depot before returning to LEO. It can use LOX/LH2 propulsion or high-power electric propulsion, with a mass scale of approximately 65 tons.
sources: 大规模低成本地月空间航天运输体系研究

other.definition_zh: 地月空间航天运输体系的组成部分之一，负责月球轨道与月面之间人员和物资的往返运输，以及月球基地与远距离月面探测点之间的快速运输。在接力式方案中，该系统包括月面着陆上升飞行器和月面大范围机动飞行器，长期驻留在EML1加注站，在轨加注后运送有效载荷至月面并返回。
other.definition_en: A component of the cislunar aerospace transportation system responsible for round-trip transport of crew and cargo between lunar orbit and the lunar surface, as well as rapid transportation between a lunar base and distant exploration sites. In the relay-style architecture, this system comprises a lunar lander/ascender and a long-range surface mobility vehicle, permanently stationed at the EML1 depot, receiving on-orbit refueling before transporting payloads to the surface and returning.
sources: 大规模低成本地月空间航天运输体系研究

other.definition_zh: 以液氢液氧为推进剂的高性能空间运输飞行器，代表国际先进的上面级技术发展方向。具备长时间在轨能力和多次在轨加注能力，提升轨道转移能力，拓展上面级在地月空间运输中的应用领域，满足大规模地月空间探索与开发任务需求。
other.definition_en: A high-performance space transfer vehicle using LOX/LH2 propellants, representing an advanced international direction for upper stage technology. It features long-duration on-orbit capability and multiple on-orbit refueling capacity, enhancing orbital transfer performance and expanding upper stage applications for cislunar transportation to meet large-scale exploration and exploitation demands.
sources: 大规模低成本地月空间航天运输体系研究

other.definition_zh: 在太空中为运载器或航天器补加推进剂的技术。是支撑航班化地月空间运输的核心能力之一，使运载器无需一次携带全部所需推进剂，大幅降低对初始起飞质量的需求。一站式方案在近地轨道实施加注，接力式方案分别在LEO加注站和EML1加注站实施两次加注。
other.definition_en: The technology of replenishing propellant to launch vehicles or spacecraft in space. It is a core enabler for airline-flight-mode cislunar transportation, eliminating the need for a vehicle to carry all required propellant at launch and dramatically reducing initial liftoff mass requirements. The one-stop solution performs refueling at LEO; the relay-style solution performs two refueling operations at the LEO depot and EML1 depot respectively.
sources: 大规模低成本地月空间航天运输体系研究

other.definition_zh: 地月空间航天运输体系的组成部分之一，实现小时内将人员和物资在地表两点之间经亚轨道快速运输。面向未来商业和军事应用，美国SpaceX、联合发射联盟(ULA)等公司和德国宇航中心等均在开发各自的全球极速运输系统。
other.definition_en: A component of the cislunar aerospace transportation system that enables transport of personnel and cargo between two surface points via suborbital flight within hours. Driven by future commercial and military applications, companies such as SpaceX, ULA, and agencies like DLR are each developing their own global express transportation systems.
sources: 大规模低成本地月空间航天运输体系研究

other.definition_zh: 设在地月拉格朗日L1点的空间推进剂补给设施，是接力式地月空间运输体系的关键中继节点。月面着陆上升飞行器在此长期驻留，在轨加注后执行EML1点与月面之间的往返运输任务。利用EML1点的地月转移能量门槛低的特性，有效降低月面运输的速度增量需求。
other.definition_en: An in-space propellant supply facility stationed at the Earth-Moon Lagrange L1 point, serving as a key relay node in the relay-style cislunar transportation architecture. The lunar lander/ascender permanently stations here, receiving on-orbit refueling before executing round-trip missions between EML1 and the lunar surface. By leveraging EML1's low energy threshold for Earth-Moon transfers, it effectively reduces the delta-V requirements for lunar surface transportation.
sources: 大规模低成本地月空间航天运输体系研究

other.definition_zh: 以液氧为氧化剂、液化天然气（甲烷）为燃料的双组元推进剂。兼顾高比冲性能和推进剂在轨贮存性，真空比冲约380秒，适用于整体任务周期长、需在轨加注的飞行器。在一站式方案中作为唯一推进剂类型，在接力式方案中用于天地往返运载火箭。SpaceX「猛禽」发动机即采用液氧甲烷推进剂。
other.definition_en: A bipropellant combination using liquid oxygen as oxidizer and liquefied natural gas (methane) as fuel. It balances high specific impulse (vacuum Isp approximately 380 s) with storable characteristics suitable for long-duration missions with on-orbit refueling. It is the sole propellant in the one-stop solution and used for the Earth-to-orbit rocket in the relay-style solution. SpaceX's Raptor engine uses LOX-methane propellant.
sources: 大规模低成本地月空间航天运输体系研究

other.definition_zh: 以液氧为氧化剂、液氢为燃料的高性能双组元推进剂。真空比冲约453秒，是当前化学推进剂中比冲最高的组合，适用于对运载效率要求高的空间转移任务。在接力式方案中用于轨道转移级和月面着陆上升飞行器，但液氢在轨长期贮存的技术难度较大。
other.definition_en: A high-performance bipropellant combination using liquid oxygen as oxidizer and liquid hydrogen as fuel. With a vacuum specific impulse of approximately 453 s, it is the highest-performing chemical propellant combination, suitable for space transfer missions demanding high mass efficiency.
